chapters.title: Chapter 3691: Infiniverse V
paragraphs: Echoes of Existence.
Some were echoes that stretched across Frequencies.
Others were of a different kind- types that many couldn't even begin to fathom.
But as the first Spoke representing a True Frequency of Entropy bloomed within the Infiniverse Megalos and caused unknown echoes to spread...
Previously scattered echoes that had bloomed from a Domus were about to make their return at this moment.
Old echoes.
Not the new echoes spreading out right now.
What the new echoes that were now spreading would bring...remained unknown.
Outside the umbrella of the Wheel of Existence.
Past its Infinite Ravines and the Gateway Domus.
Beyond a silver rift flickering within the endless layers of the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
HUUM!
The folds of collapse, existence, and nonexistence quaked as terrifying auras emerged, one after another.
Each more dreadful than the last.
At the forefront stood a childlike humanoid, its weavings actively devouring the surrounding strands of existence.
A grin stretched permanently from ear to ear. Its eyes were pure obsidian. Cold. Merciless.
Veltraxis, the Smiling Empty Maw.
He had been alerted by Vha'Nekrul, the Harmonized Sourcebound Icon who had watched Noah empower the Great Beyonder and Veyl'Aethra within a certain Gateway Domus.
Veltraxis appeared, his eerie smile sharpened with purpose. His body grew- dead skin tearing and expanding as waves of obsidian death and wonder rippled across him.

Now, he stood as a towering skeletal silhouette cloaked in shadow-threaded robes that flowed like liquefied void. Spiked bone protrusions crowned his head like a twisted halo, and his maw stretched unnaturally wide, filled with serrated, smiling teeth. His limbs tapered into tendrils, swaying as if whispering secrets to the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
His Complexity... was High.
High!
Not Average. Not Moderate.
High!

Around him, massive Dead Things of similar Complexity manifested one after another, each more unstable than the last. Their weavings barely held together by Sorrowglass True Source Panaceas- without which, they would become Fractal Beings.

Veltraxis, the Smiling Empty Maw, stood before the gateway- its infinite edges flickering with threads of decayed stars and devoured timelines. His hollow smile widened as his voice rang out- a paradox of elegance and entropy.

"For cycles uncounted, we have wandered...half-things, hollow, converged into this mockery of form. And why? Because we believed. Because we hoped. Because we hunted the Loom. Each Wheel whispered fragments, echoes of a pattern... but never the whole. Some gave us strands. Others? Silence. Absolutely fucking nothing. But this one... this Wheel of Existence... it sings of vibrant True Sources. It might hold a melody. And if it hides a piece of the Loom within its Spokes..."

"Then we shall strip it bare. Burn its Frequencies. Shatter its weavings until it bleeds the truth we were denied. We are tired of being Dead Things pretending to live. I want my True Source alive again- bright, burning, unforgotten! The rest of you feel the same, yes?!"
HUUM!
His weavings buzzed as monstrous forms of beings with Below Average Purity but High Complexity seethed behind him. One stepped forward- a hunchback giant composed entirely of writhing worms.
"O 77th Mawbearer of Recursive Hunger, shall I alert nearby Mawbearers of this possibility?"
The worm-entity asked as Veltraxis turned his cold gaze upon it.
He, Veltraxis, was the 77th Mawbearer of the One Hundred Mawbearers of the Hollow Concord of Nullity.
A legion of beings. Of Dead Things. United under a singular cause in this region of the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
The Concord of Hollow Nullity was a dreadful pantheon of Dead Things—forgotten champions, broken Architects, and failed Monads—bound by an agonizing purpose: to become alive again.
Scattered across the Nullvein Gravewake Folds, these entities once held True Sources now lost to collapse and death. They clawed through shattered timelines in search of the Loom.
At their heart stood the One Hundred Mawbearers—horrors of vast intellect and warped might. They sought not salvation.
They sought reclamation—of essence, of memory, of meaning. They were not born to be hollow.
They would not remain so.
Veltraxis shook his head.

"It is merely a single Wheel of Existence—one that already bears the stench of multiple Breakings. At best, there will be a Resplendent Monad or two. If it were a Wheel yet untouched... unbroken... it would be teeming with Monads and Converged Architects, and more of the One Hundred would be summoned. But this? This will be our feast. Let us go."
WAA!
Their bodies pulsed with heavy Dead True Sources.
Without delay, they dove into the Gateway Domus—now an overlap of four Wild True Sources: Causality, Fear, Verbum, and Oxidation.

The Hollow Cascade of Reversed Causality, the Pale Verbum Labyrinth, and the Domus of Absolute Fear of Existence twisted and collided with the fourth—once guarded by the Origin Singed—the Domus of Oxidation.
In that moment, Veltraxis, a Converged Architect, and fourteen other Dead Things of similar power stepped through the veiled Domus doorway and into the Infinite Ravines.
Among the 14, Vha'Nekrul who had reported to him could also be seen!
Within a certain Gateway Domus.

The Mythic Signature of the Great Beyonder brought down her hand. Upon impact, eighty-one Pillars of Concordance bloomed all at once, converging upon a single Dead Thing whose True Source nearly shattered.
Almost.
But a sliver remained.
From nowhere, tendrils of gold wrapped around it, dragging its weavings toward the chest of none other than Noah.
Into his Cradle of Purity.
There, its Complexity would be dismantled and consumed.
"Haha... that's the last of the Dead Things! We actually cleared all the Gateway Domus!"
The expression on the Great Beyonder's vast Mythic Signature radiated triumph- the power of a Quasi-Resplendent Monad alive in her gaze, swirling with trillions of runes.
With the efforts of Noah and Veyl'Aethra beside her, every Dead Thing in the region—each only Harmonized Sourcebound Icons of Moderate Complexity and Below Average Purity—had either fled or perished.
Some, like this one, were preserved. Noah had gathered a total of nine Dead Things and their True Sources into his Cradle of Purity.
The rest were erased beneath the relentless force of the Great Beyonder's Mythic Signature.
She was becoming more and more familiar with her power as she turned towards Noah at this moment with shining eyes, her voice firm and filled with power.
"It seems like your arrival has changed many things. More and more dead things will keep falling as the dire situation of the Infinite Ravines will soon be turned."

chapters.title: Chapter 3692: Infiniverse VI
paragraphs: The Great Beyonder once again spoke with positivity.
And Noah heard it- and instantly, alarm bells rang in his mind.
Because the last time she had spoken with such optimism, it was right before another Gateway Domus had emerged, forcing itself upon the others already present, followed by a downpour of Dead Things.
And now she spoke in a similarly hopeful tone, even going so far as to mention that the dire nature of the Infinite Ravines had shifted because of him.
Noah glanced around as he heard this, his expression stern, as if bracing for an imminent shift the moment her words ended.
She noticed and harrumphed, rolling her eyes.

"Do you think I'm some kind of jinx? That every time I talk about things getting better, something comes crashing down to prove me wrong? The Weavings of Existence don't work like that. There are coincidences, and then there are-...!"
She stopped.
Veyl'Aethra, who had been watching them both, suddenly froze.
His smile faded into something quiet. Something sorrowful.
The face of the Great Beyonder turned pale. Her eyes trembled with a mixture of shock and fury as both her gaze and the gaze of her Mythic Signature snapped toward the distance.
And Noah sighed.
He knew it had nothing to do with her words.
He knew.
But still, every time she made a positive comment, existence itself seemed determined to prove her wrong.
At that moment, all of them turned toward a distant region of the twisting, overlapping Gateway Domus.
From there... a pressure surged.
Terrifying and heavy, eclipsing even the Quasi-Resplendent Monad aura of the Great Beyonder.
And there was more than one.
Vile and saturated with the weavings of the dead.
Sensing it, Veyl'Aethra's sorrow deepened. He shook his head solemnly- and then, his body flickered and distorted, as if his very existence were lagging or shifting into something else.
Noah caught this anomaly with his current perception just as his attention shifted toward the approaching auras- now becoming visible.
The veiled threshold of the Gateway Domus tore open with a thunderous hum.
A Dead Thing of horrifying complexity stepped through first.
Noah's eyes flared with a blinding light, bursting with complex, exceedingly pure power as his distinction as the Weaver of Existence surged forth.
And above this newcomer, a name appeared:
[Veltraxis, the Smiling Empty Maw (Converged Architect)]
Clear and undeniable.
And it only made Noah's expression harden further.

Veltraxis, the Smiling Empty Maw, strode forward like death incarnate clothed in splendor. His skeletal frame loomed tall, draped in shadow-threaded robes that rippled like liquefied void. A twisted halo of bone spires crowned his head, and his grinning maw revealed serrated teeth in an unending smile.
Behind him came the Fourteen Dead Things—monstrosities of ruin, from titanic worm-hives to void-armored husks, each pulsing with raw, unstable Dead True Sources.
They stood in a perfect, menacing semi-circle.
The air bent and bled around them, their presence rupturing the wild weavings of True Sources across the Domus.
Noah, Veyl'Aethra, and the Great Beyonder grew even more somber, their eyes narrowing.
Collapse itself had entered the battlefield-heralded by Veltraxis, whose cold, endless grin stretched as he calmly uttered...
"Hello."
BOOM!
The sound echoed like a divine decree.
The Gateway Domus trembled violently. And then—suddenly—it surged upward, folding and unraveling across countless layers of existence.
It wasn't that another region was being drawn into theirs.
It was their Gateway Domus...being forcibly merged into another.
A judgment had been made: the three of them alone weren't enough to face what was coming.
And truly, when faced with fourteen Converged Architects, failed Resplendent Monads, and even a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon- what could the Wheel do but yield?

Noah kept his gaze fixed on the other Dead Things accompanying Veltraxis. Though their power was slightly less than his, it was still far too complex for even a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon-level being to stand against.
Even with his current complexity, Noah knew he could not harm their True Sources for now.
But that might not remain true even an hour from now, as the Infiniverse Megalos underwent a terrifying ascension.
BOOOM!
Reality split apart.
The Domus shattered and reformed with a loud, jarring bang—and when it reassembled, it was no longer in the same place.
Now, they were somewhere else entirely.
A place dominated by a single, terrifying aura.
Structures of fractured brilliance swirled around them.
Ten Wild True Sources flowed freely, clashing and weaving in chaotic majesty.
Crystal mountains glittered in one direction. Fiery hellscapes churned in another.
Colors and wonder bled through every crevice of the air.
And yet... most striking of all was an endless gray sea, its waters thick with ash.
There were no Dead Things here.
Only this ash-covered expanse, surrounded by hundreds of radiant gray pillars.
Floating above the gray sea was a solitary figure—a middle-aged man with dark hair and tan skin. A robe of smoke and shadow billowed around him, and he radiated nothing but calm and quiet awe.
Noah locked eyes with him.
And he remembered the words of the Witness—about a Resplendent Monad who had survived since the Eighth Breaking of the Wheel.
The holder of the True Source of Asche.
At that moment, their Gateway Domus had fully merged into his, bringing along fifteen Dead Things—most of them on par with Resplendent Monads.
Noah breathed through the chaos and turned inward.
To his own power.
Because no matter what the outer weavings did, he could count on himself.
On his weavings.
And now, with monstrosities arriving from every corner, he focused inwards—on the Infiniverse Megalos.
On his True Source Atlas of Existence, on Ruination, and the complex Dead Things of the Cradle of Purity that he would one day devour.
From deep within, the Infiniverse Megalos spoke to him.
"Through any Weavings of Existence... I will be here, Master."
HUUM!
Her voice rang with serenity and solemn resolve.
She could see what he saw.
She understood what now stood before them.
And so, she accelerated her transformation.
Her voice echoed again, reassuring him:
"Master, others will gain their own boons from the True Frequencies of the Infiniverse Megalos. But you... you will have something else entirely."
WAA!

"For you, the entire True Frequency of Entropy—newly constructed—is available to grasp and wield. It will allow you to channel its intricate weavings and the full complexity of the Infiniverse... into a single, focused point, expressed through the True Source of Entropy- through the Spoke of Entropy."
"I will begin working on Continuity next... followed by Manadynamics, and all the rest... until the Infiniverse Megalos takes its final step- becoming the Infiniverse Wheel of Existence."

sentences.text: The Great Beyonder once again spoke with positivity.
And Noah heard it- and instantly, alarm bells rang in his mind.
Because the last time she had spoken with such optimism, it was right before another Gateway Domus had emerged, forcing itself upon the others already present, followed by a downpour of Dead Things.
And now she spoke in a similarly hopeful tone, even going so far as to mention that the dire nature of the Infinite Ravines had shifted because of him.
Noah glanced around as he heard this, his expression stern, as if bracing for an imminent shift the moment her words ended.
She noticed and harrumphed, rolling her eyes.
"Do you think I'm some kind of jinx?
That every time I talk about things getting better, something comes crashing down to prove me wrong?
The Weavings of Existence don't work like that.
There are coincidences, and then there are-...!"
She stopped.
Veyl'Aethra, who had been watching them both, suddenly froze.
His smile faded into something quiet.
Something sorrowful.
The face of the Great Beyonder turned pale.
Her eyes trembled with a mixture of shock and fury as both her gaze and the gaze of her Mythic Signature snapped toward the distance.
And Noah sighed.
He knew it had nothing to do with her words.
He knew.
But still, every time she made a positive comment, existence itself seemed determined to prove her wrong.
At that moment, all of them turned toward a distant region of the twisting, overlapping Gateway Domus.
From there... a pressure surged.
Terrifying and heavy, eclipsing even the Quasi-Resplendent Monad aura of the Great Beyonder.
And there was more than one.
Vile and saturated with the weavings of the dead.
Sensing it, Veyl'Aethra's sorrow deepened.
He shook his head solemnly- and then, his body flickered and distorted, as if his very existence were lagging or shifting into something else.
Noah caught this anomaly with his current perception just as his attention shifted toward the approaching auras- now becoming visible.
The veiled threshold of the Gateway Domus tore open with a thunderous hum.
A Dead Thing of horrifying complexity stepped through first.
Noah's eyes flared with a blinding light, bursting with complex, exceedingly pure power as his distinction as the Weaver of Existence surged forth.
And above this newcomer, a name appeared:
[Veltraxis, the Smiling Empty Maw (Converged Architect)]
Clear and undeniable.
And it only made Noah's expression harden further.
Veltraxis, the Smiling Empty Maw, strode forward like death incarnate clothed in splendor.
His skeletal frame loomed tall, draped in shadow-threaded robes that rippled like liquefied void.
A twisted halo of bone spires crowned his head, and his grinning maw revealed serrated teeth in an unending smile.
Behind him came the Fourteen Dead Things—monstrosities of ruin, from titanic worm-hives to void-armored husks, each pulsing with raw, unstable Dead True Sources.
They stood in a perfect, menacing semi-circle.
The air bent and bled around them, their presence rupturing the wild weavings of True Sources across the Domus.
Noah, Veyl'Aethra, and the Great Beyonder grew even more somber, their eyes narrowing.
Collapse itself had entered the battlefield-heralded by Veltraxis, whose cold, endless grin stretched as he calmly uttered...
"Hello."
BOOM!
The sound echoed like a divine decree.
The Gateway Domus trembled violently.
And then—suddenly—it surged upward, folding and unraveling across countless layers of existence.
It wasn't that another region was being drawn into theirs.
It was their Gateway Domus...being forcibly merged into another.
A judgment had been made: the three of them alone weren't enough to face what was coming.
And truly, when faced with fourteen Converged Architects, failed Resplendent Monads, and even a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon- what could the Wheel do but yield?
Noah kept his gaze fixed on the other Dead Things accompanying Veltraxis.
Though their power was slightly less than his, it was still far too complex for even a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon-level being to stand against.
Even with his current complexity, Noah knew he could not harm their True Sources for now.
But that might not remain true even an hour from now, as the Infiniverse Megalos underwent a terrifying ascension.
BOOOM!
Reality split apart.
The Domus shattered and reformed with a loud, jarring bang—and when it reassembled, it was no longer in the same place.
Now, they were somewhere else entirely.
A place dominated by a single, terrifying aura.
Structures of fractured brilliance swirled around them.
Ten Wild True Sources flowed freely, clashing and weaving in chaotic majesty.
Crystal mountains glittered in one direction.
Fiery hellscapes churned in another.
Colors and wonder bled through every crevice of the air.
And yet... most striking of all was an endless gray sea, its waters thick with ash.
There were no Dead Things here.
Only this ash-covered expanse, surrounded by hundreds of radiant gray pillars.
Floating above the gray sea was a solitary figure—a middle-aged man with dark hair and tan skin.
A robe of smoke and shadow billowed around him, and he radiated nothing but calm and quiet awe.
Noah locked eyes with him.
And he remembered the words of the Witness—about a Resplendent Monad who had survived since the Eighth Breaking of the Wheel.
The holder of the True Source of Asche.
At that moment, their Gateway Domus had fully merged into his, bringing along fifteen Dead Things—most of them on par with Resplendent Monads.
Noah breathed through the chaos and turned inward.
To his own power.
Because no matter what the outer weavings did, he could count on himself.
On his weavings.
And now, with monstrosities arriving from every corner, he focused inwards—on the Infiniverse Megalos.
On his True Source Atlas of Existence, on Ruination, and the complex Dead Things of the Cradle of Purity that he would one day devour.
From deep within, the Infiniverse Megalos spoke to him.
"Through any Weavings of Existence...
I will be here, Master."
HUUM!
Her voice rang with serenity and solemn resolve.
She could see what he saw.
She understood what now stood before them.
And so, she accelerated her transformation.
Her voice echoed again, reassuring him:
"Master, others will gain their own boons from the True Frequencies of the Infiniverse Megalos.
But you... you will have something else entirely."
WAA!
"For you, the entire True Frequency of Entropy—newly constructed—is available to grasp and wield.

It will allow you to channel its intricate weavings and the full complexity of the Infiniverse... into a single, focused point, expressed through the True Source of Entropy- through the Spoke of Entropy."
"I will begin working on Continuity next... followed by Manadynamics, and all the rest... until the Infiniverse Megalos takes its final step- becoming the Infiniverse Wheel of Existence."

chapters.title: Chapter 3693: One After Another I
paragraphs: The Infiniverse Wheel of Existence.
That was the end goal. The destination. The apex the Infiniverse strained toward!
And it had to be enough.
Because Noah couldn't fail- not now, and not ever.

Others could stumble. Others could break. But him? Even his worst mistakes were victories in disguise. He thought of Bob, and how things had played out. A failure, maybe. But only by his impossible standards.
Anyone else would've seen it for what it was: a successful stand against a monstrous Dead Thing, denying him at every turn until he was finally forced to withdraw.
Now, another challenge had risen.
This time? It was multiple Dead Things. Entities on the level of Resplendent Monads and Converged Architects.
They towered in complexity, vastly beyond him. But they were far inferior in purity.
Noah's mind raced, turning over the dynamic interplay between power, purity, and complexity.
What happens when someone of extreme purity collides with someone of massive complexity?
Which would prevail?
If his current purity was at the "Moderate" level, could the presence of multiple pure True Sources tip the scale- even against something like a Dead Thing Converged Architect?
He hadn't known the answer. Not before.
But now... now, he had test subjects.
If he survived the clash with them, that is.
At that moment, within the Infiniverse Megalos, a radiant violet Spoke surged from the Infiniverse Vein and stretched outward- farther and farther- until it reached the very edge of what was visible.
And there, from the tip, a ring began to form.
It curved, arcing outward, until it wrapped the Infiniverse itself in a luminous outline.
The outer ring...
Of a Wheel of Existence.
Unfathomable. Impossible.
And yet it was happening- right here before his eyes!
|The True Source of Entropy has bloomed within your Weavings of Existence.|

|The True Source of Entropy is connected to the True Frequency of Entropy, holding Limited Absolute Purity at its core. The True Source itself has been forged with Moderate Complexity and Quasi-High Purity.|
He hadn't even moved yet, and answers were already arriving.
Others climbed slowly- they chose a path, forged a single True Source, and walked a careful line.
But Noah? His path was never meant to be like anyone else's. He didn't forge a True Source.
He forged multiple.
And the Infiniverse... it didn't just help him create more of them, it linked them to True Frequencies of Existence!
It gave him access to forces no other existence could ever hope to touch.
Like now, Entropy. A freshly forged True Source.
And because it was connected to a True Frequency of Limited Absolute Purity...
His own True Source of Entropy emerged with Quasi-High Purity and Moderate Complexity.
Moderate alone could crown someone a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon.
High could elevate them to a Resplendent Monad or Converged Architect.
But Quasi-High?
That placed him right in between- exactly like the Great Beyonder.
And this? This was just the first True Source the Infiniverse had birthed.
More were coming. Each tethered to its own True Frequency and each adding its own Quasi-High Purity to him.
How many would he need?
How long until he reached a state to rival- or even surpass- a Resplendent Monad?
He didn't have that answer yet.
But soon, he would!
HUUM!
As violet flames of Entropy raged in his Weavings of Existence, Noah stood motionless, absorbing it all.
Entropy.
Entropy!
|Through the Weavings of the True Source of Entropy, Echoes of Finality may now be utilized.|

|Fractured Echoes obtained from your Records will be randomly unleashed, granting them Fractured Echo Forms imbued with the unraveling chaos of Entropy. Their presence alone can slowly deteriorate the True Source of any opposition. When a Mythic True Signature is used to channel the Echoes of Finality, their potency escalates exponentially.|

|Existential Reset is also now possible, allowing your Weavings to revert to a Zero-State. However, this is not recommended as your current state is the most optimal, and it is not guaranteed you will return to it should you Reset.|
This was what the others in his Infiniverse could wield.
And while he could, technically... he didn't need to.
His outcome was already the best one possible.
Even as he adjusted to the burning weight of Entropy, something new was also beginning as the Infiniverse moved relentlessly.
|The True Frequency of Continuity has begun to be forged.|
From a point on the opposite end of the Infiniverse Vein, a white-green brilliance sparked to life.
Another Spoke was forming.
Another True Source was on its way.
And in the middle of it all...
"Let me wield your first Spoke of Entropy in this newly merging Domus. I want to see if I can smack a Converged Architect around with it..."
Noah's eyes glowed with the quiet light of tyranny of a man who had already decided the outcome.
And the answer, as always...
"Yes, Master."
Affirmation.
Obedience.
The violet Spoke of the Infiniverse Wheel shimmered.
Its weavings surged across dimensions, connecting to his construct through an unshakable bond.
It would cross countless realities to arrive...in the depths of the Infinite Ravines.
The Infinite Ravines.
Inside a Gateway Domus where over a dozen Wild True Sources converged and flared, their Weavings of Existence thrashing violently.
Any Harmonized Sourcebound Icon would struggle here.
There were too many forces. Too much pressure.
It was almost too much for Veyl'Aethra- his face pale, his True Source wrapped tight around him just to survive.
The Great Beyonder stood steady.
Her purity, on its way to becoming truly High, insulated her from the worst of it.
Noah?
He stood still, his body bubbling with power.
He matched the Great Beyonder now- purity for purity. Complexity for complexity.
And as he stared across the expanse, his gaze found the source of the rising dread.
A congregation of Dead Things loomed, watching.
Their attention turned sharply toward a single figure.
The holder of the True Source of Asche.
A man with gray hair and a beard of the same. His robes, billowing shadow-ash gray, flowed as he sat atop a sea of gray ash.
Everything around him whispered with the same color, the same finality.
Veltraxis, the Smiling Empty Maw, had fixed his monstrous gaze on this man- believing him the only threat.
But he was wrong!
Because while the Great Beyonder and Veyl'Aethra were frozen, tense and uncertain, Noah stepped forward, calm and composed.
His voice sliced through the stillness like a Quintessential blade.

"Before all the craziness kicks off... would you all mind introducing yourselves? Maybe tell me why, exactly, you've chosen now to enter the Infinite Ravines? Because this doesn't look like a random appearance...this looks coordinated. So tell me, what brings you all to our home?"
His voice was calm.
Measured.
But behind it throbbed power. Unapologetic. Unrelenting. Tyrannical. Quintessential!
And suddenly, every eye, alive and not, turned to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 3694: One After Another II
paragraphs: What brings you all to our home?
He asked it plainly- at a moment soaked in tension, when most would've struggled to breathe, let alone speak.
But Noah, even with the storm of destruction and chaos looming over them all, stood there- fearless and unshaken, as if making small talk over the weavings of existence

Far ahead, just beyond a row of fourteen Dead Things, Veltraxis, the Smiling Empty Maw, turned his attention from the ashen horizon and grinned. Edge to edge. That smile deepened as he looked between Noah and the holder of the True Source of Asche.
And then, he spoke.

"If you were any other Harmonized Sourcebound Icon, I might've glanced at that Resplendent Monad standing beside you and asked why he let something so fragile speak for him. But since you are directly responsible for our arrival here... I'll indulge your disrespectful little question. It was you."
It was him?
Noah blinked, disbelieving.
What the fuck did he mean it was him?
The Great Beyonder's gaze sharpened, her eyes narrowing as Veltraxis's grin widened further—so wide now it seemed his entire face was a smile carved into dead flesh.
He lifted a dead hand, motioning to the side—toward the only Harmonized Sourcebound Icon among his monstrous entourage.
"This one here saw you. In your Gateway. From a distance. He witnessed you ignite a white-gold flame that could actually empower and fortify other True Sources."

"You see... the alteration of any True Source, whether it's one's own or someone else's, is nearly impossible. When it does occur, it's the result of something... singular. A presence standing beyond conventional power. Something tied to a special kind of Wheel of Existence. That's why I came. To confirm whether what you wield is that kind of Wheel. In truth... us being here? It's your fault. Your existence, the uniqueness of it, called us. Isn't it beautiful?"
HUUM!
Heavy words.
But the words weren't admiration.
They were psychotic, laced with manic glee—spoken by something that didn't just want to watch the existence burn, but wanted to dance in the ashes.
Noah's gaze sharpened, glowing brighter with each breath.
They came because of him?
Because of the Singed?
He wanted to call it bullshit, but...at the same time, looking at his long history, was he actually the thing that invited apocalypses, catastrophes, and destruction?
Before he could speak, another voice rose- ancient, amused, and unmistakably alive.
"Oh, come on. A white-gold flame that empowers True Sources? Is that all it takes to make Dead Things giddy these days?"
The voice of the Holder of the True Source of Asche echoed like a song from the grave- timeless and unbothered, even here, in the maw of chaos.
A slow smile tugged at his ageless face.
Veltraxis turned toward the Sea of Ash, answering curtly.
"These days? Everything makes Dead Things jumpy. Every day, we inch closer to True Death.
I am the 77th Mawbearer of Recursive Hunger—part of the Concord of Hollow Nullity...

There are others like us...Dead Things searching for the same answer. For the same thing. Even Living Things clawing to stop the Last Breaking of their Wheels are looking for it. Tell me... can you blame our desperation?"
WAA!
He dropped words that could unhinge a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon.
The 77th Mawbearer?
That meant there were at least seventy-six more like him.
And more, if the number wasn't symbolic.
The Concord of Hollow Nullity wasn't alone.
There were other factions of Dead Things like it.
Other nightmares moving across existence like cancer through stars.
And...
"Fucking hell..."
Noah cursed aloud, his eyes burning with tyranny as his thoughts snapped into focus.
These monsters could not be allowed to leave.
Not one.
Somehow, some way—they all had to die.
A strange light began to rise from within him—a bloom of power so complex it seemed to bend the space around him.
Without a word, he stepped forward, flames already flickering across his skin.
The Great Beyonder moved, almost reached for him, but Noah brushed her hand aside with a small, reassuring pat.
He didn't stop.
From his right hand, violet flames ignited—layered with the familiar brilliance of white-gold, the signature of the Singed.
To the outside world, it looked like a crystallized pillar of white-gold light was forming—a spear wrapped in entropy, impossibly dense.
He was summoning the Spoke of Entropy, hidden behind the veil of his white gold flame.
He couldn't reveal his weavings too freely, after all.
Then, he turned back to Veltraxis and the others, nodding casually.

"So... you all came here with grand intentions. Trying to break through to the Wheel of Existence, right? Anyone feel like a quick warm-up? Just me, a humble little Harmonized Sourcebound Icon...Versus, let's say... not your weakest, but your only Harmonized Sourcebound Icon. That'd be you, right? Vha'Nekrul?"
The Weaver of Existence made names clear.
The pillar in his hand—sleek and razor-edged—snapped into position, the point aimed directly at the Dead Thing who had once observed him in silence.
The skeletal being's eyes flared in rage at being called the weakest.
Noah didn't even acknowledge it.
He kept going.
"Actually... no. Let's skip that. I'll fight a Converged Architect instead."
His smile returned, calm and filled with tyranny.
"The weakest among them."
And then...
The Spoke moved.
It pointed.
Dead silence followed.
It landed on a towering, hunchbacked Dead Thing.
A grotesque creature made entirely of sleek, writhing worms—each one twitching in unison, like a hive that wore a corpse as armor.
A ripple of recognition passed through Noah's eyes as the distinction of the Weaver of Existence worked freely.
"M'gorrhaal, The Crawling Colossus. Holder of the Dead True Source of Infestation."
"Think you can handle someone as tiny as me?"
Noah's voice dripped with majesty now, each syllable stabbing at the pride of the Dead Things across from him.
M'gorrhaal trembled.
Not in fear, but in hunger—barely holding himself back.
And then, Veltraxis raised a hand—silent and fluid—and gave the command.
Go.
The Crawling Colossus moved.
Towering. Slouching. Writhing.
The battlefield shifted with each thunderous step.
A 1 v 1.
A Harmonized Sourcebound Icon versus a Converged Architect.
On paper, the result should've been clear.
But none of them—not even Veltraxis—understood what Noah held.
In his hand wasn't just a True Source.
It was a Spoke.
A fragment of a Wheel.
A weight of existence itself.
And now, the outcome?
Was unknown.

"Fucking hell..."
Noah cursed aloud, his eyes burning with tyranny as his thoughts snapped into focus.
These monsters could not be allowed to leave.
Not one.
Somehow, some way—they all had to die.
A strange light began to rise from within him—a bloom of power so complex it seemed to bend the space around him.
Without a word, he stepped forward, flames already flickering across his skin.
The Great Beyonder moved, almost reached for him, but Noah brushed her hand aside with a small, reassuring pat.
He didn't stop.
From his right hand, violet flames ignited—layered with the familiar brilliance of white-gold, the signature of the Singed.
To the outside world, it looked like a crystallized pillar of white-gold light was forming—a spear wrapped in entropy, impossibly dense.
He was summoning the Spoke of Entropy, hidden behind the veil of his white gold flame.
He couldn't reveal his weavings too freely, after all.
Then, he turned back to Veltraxis and the others, nodding casually.
"So... you all came here with grand intentions.
Trying to break through to the Wheel of Existence, right?
Anyone feel like a quick warm-up?
Just me, a humble little Harmonized Sourcebound Icon...Versus, let's say... not your weakest, but your only Harmonized Sourcebound Icon.
That'd be you, right?
Vha'Nekrul?"
The Weaver of Existence made names clear.
The pillar in his hand—sleek and razor-edged—snapped into position, the point aimed directly at the Dead Thing who had once observed him in silence.
The skeletal being's eyes flared in rage at being called the weakest.
Noah didn't even acknowledge it.
He kept going.
"Actually... no.
Let's skip that.
I'll fight a Converged Architect instead."
His smile returned, calm and filled with tyranny.
"The weakest among them."
And then...
The Spoke moved.
It pointed.
Dead silence followed.
It landed on a towering, hunchbacked Dead Thing.
A grotesque creature made entirely of sleek, writhing worms—each one twitching in unison, like a hive that wore a corpse as armor.
A ripple of recognition passed through Noah's eyes as the distinction of the Weaver of Existence worked freely.
"M'gorrhaal, The Crawling Colossus.
Holder of the Dead True Source of Infestation."
"Think you can handle someone as tiny as me?"
Noah's voice dripped with majesty now, each syllable stabbing at the pride of the Dead Things across from him.
M'gorrhaal trembled.
Not in fear, but in hunger—barely holding himself back.
And then, Veltraxis raised a hand—silent and fluid—and gave the command.
Go.
The Crawling Colossus moved.
Towering.
Slouching.
Writhing.
The battlefield shifted with each thunderous step.
A 1 v 1.
A Harmonized Sourcebound Icon versus a Converged Architect.
On paper, the result should've been clear.
But none of them—not even Veltraxis—understood what Noah held.
In his hand wasn't just a True Source.
It was a Spoke.
A fragment of a Wheel.
A weight of existence itself.
And now, the outcome?
Was unknown.

chapters.title: Chapter 3695: One After Another III
paragraphs: M'gorrhaal, the Crawling Colossus. Holder of the Dead True Source of Infestation.
This was his title- a distinction that, in this moment, stood as he faced the singular figure of Noah.
It was as if every other Source of Existence, dead or living, had vanished.
And beneath the weave of their Existences, only the two of them remained.
Even though the Great Beyonder and Veyl'Aethra warred behind Noah, their gazes were solemn and turbulent as they tried desperately to find a way out.
Even in the far distance, the figure holding the True Source of Asche watched in silence, his face carved with a smile that barely veiled the intensity and seriousness behind his eyes.

Even farther, across from them, near the grotesque creature that held the Dead True Source of Infestation- Veltraxis hovered in a manner that inspired dread. The surrounding weavings of Existence were passively drawn and devoured by him, including the many wild True Sources.
But all of that faded.
Only the two of them seemed to exist now.
And Noah...
"You're one ugly fucker, aren't you? What exactly were you when you were alive? Do you even remember?"
His words caused M'gorrhaal to pulse violently, his True Source of Infestation flaring.
The Dead Thing didn't answer- not immediately. It simply stared at Noah with a bottomless hunger, drawn to his purity as if it carried a divine aroma.
The millions of worms writhing across its face wiggled, salivating, as its ancient, dead voice echoed out.
"The Blooming Womb of Rot."
HUUM!
The surroundings pulsed, their colors rotting into a diseased green and ashen gray.
The True Source of Infestation bloomed wildly, and above M'gorrhaal, a Dead Mythic True Signature materialized with virulent malice.

It appeared as a dead, skeletal worm composed of trillions of lesser worms. Its height towered over a hundred Omniverses, crowned with serrated bony jaws and a grotesquely pulsing, stomach-like core that split open like a wound, spewing verdant-gray tides of madness.
The True Source of Infestation had fully unfolded.
The Blooming Womb of Rot bloomed.
This plague-forged biome pulsed like living flesh—birthing bio-organic spires, twitching tendrils, and eyeless larvae that exhaled pestilence into the air.
Noah read its nature clearly as he gripped the Spoke in his hand tighter.

Once this Source was activated, every wound, pore, and orifice in any Living or Dead Thing within range could become a potential birthing point for parasitic Infestlings—limb-wrapped horrors that gestated at an accelerated rate of existence.
They would spread across the opposing True Sources and devour their hosts from within...unless purged.
Only cleansing from a True Source of High Purity or High Complexity could counter them.
That was the only real path to resistance- the only way one could hope to overcome such infestation.
The eyeless larvae and virulent seas surged toward Noah like a pestilent tide.
And opposite him, M'gorrhaal's deep, guttural voice echoed again:
"You...are mighty."
WAA!
"You...are tasty."
"Let me feed, O Living True Source filled with Purity."
Its voice radiated authority, and the festering sea beneath it seemed to salivate, drawn toward Noah's terrifyingly radiant essence.
But Noah only gripped the spear-shaped Spoke and thrust it forward as he spoke:
"Echoes of Finality."
Echoes.
Of Finality.
He invoked them.
Fractured Echoes gathered from his Records surged outward, manifesting in Echo Forms imbued with Entropy's unraveling chaos.
And at that instant—
Noah's eyes flared with violet light.

|Echoes of Finality have scoured your Records and randomly selected the Fractured Echo Form of Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique - First Form: The Descent of the Ascendant Severing Soul Star.|
An old weaving. A piece of him.
Part of his Record.
|The Echo of Finality: Shattered Entropic Wheel is blooming.|
Behind and above him, a violet "star" bloomed—though it wasn't truly a star. And it was covered by the flames of the Singed.
It was the True Source of Entropy, transformed into a Mythic True Signature.
A Shattered Wheel, its sole Spoke stretching the size of 1,000 Omniverses, bloomed with violent grace.
Yet it burned with white-gold flames.
The Wheel appeared as a broken celestial structure—its lone Spoke pointed directly at the onrushing tide of infestation.
But it didn't move.
It didn't need to.
Because the original Record of the Ascendant Severing Soul Star was deceptively simple.

[Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique - First Form]: ...The Assassin Emperor of Severance becomes a multi-target effect against all who gaze upon the Star of Illumination. It can only chain once under multi-target status....
A forgotten power.
Yet under the influence of Entropy, it became something far more magnificent—reforged into a white-gold Wheel of severing judgment.
And when the trillions of eyes making up M'gorrhaal gazed upon the Wheel...
SUUU!
From the broken Wheel, unfathomable flashes of existence surged toward the grotesque gray-green tide!
Toward the very sea birthed from a Dead True Source of Infestation!
These radiant severing lights carried more than Entropy. Disguised as white-gold, they bore the force of the Spoke itself.
They bore the weight of the Infiniverse Megalos.
Entropy alone—Quasi-High Purity and Moderate Complexity, was staggering.
But now it merged with the Spoke, a literal anchor of the True Frequency of Entropy, and the heavy burden of the Infiniverse's Complexity.
It was weighty.
It was overwhelming.
His own Purity, the Spoke, the very framework of Complexity—merged into a singular, fantastical strike.
Against the Mythic True Signature of a Converged Architect with High Complexity—Noah's Severing Lights of Existence flashed.
And the horrid tide of pestilence that spread so widely...
Was cut.
Shredded apart as if it had never been.
The corruption disintegrated in white-gold fire—there one instant, gone the next.
Only M'gorrhaal remained.
Above him, the massive skeletal worm writhed—then shattered beneath the brilliance of Purity and Complexity.
M'gorrhaal himself...
CUT!
Split down the center.
CUT! CUT!
More pieces followed, his High Complexity flaring wildly—his end nearing True Death as space warped.
And the final severing strike dragged what was left of his body before Noah.
Golden tendrils erupted from Noah's chest and devoured everything that remained of the Dead Thing.
Instantly.
Too fast!
The weakest Converged Architect among the Dead Things...had been erased.
But...
That wasn't all.
The Shattered Entropic Wheel, which drew from the Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique - First Form...
Was multi-target.
And behind M'gorrhaal...
There were many more targets.

chapters.title: Chapter 3696: One After Another IV
paragraphs: The Weakest Converged Architect among those who entered was decimated as his True Source of Infestation was overwhelmed by something it didn't even understand!

And above Noah, the massive Mythic True Signature of a Shattered Entropic Wheel with a single spoke remained. Its tremendously fast attacks—based on the record of the Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique, First Form—swept out at this moment on all enemies that gazed upon it!
The weavings of existence where only Noah and the Holder of the True Source of Infestation were contained seemingly broke down, as everyone in the surroundings became visible once more.
And the effects of the Shattered Entropic Wheel spread as they seemed like unfathomably fast blades of existence, seeking to cut down every Dead Thing in sight.
But...
The figure of Veltraxis, the Smiling Empty Maw, stepped forward.
He stood before all of the Dead Things as the attacks surging toward them—and those hurtling toward him—converged in his direction.
His smile deepened.
And in the next instant, existence itself began to fold, constrict, and collapse around them.
Near them all, the possible weavings of the living True Sources of Existence ceased to exert their effects.

In his hands, Noah felt the terrifying True Source of Entropy he held—his Spoke—vibrate as he received a horrific backlash. The weavings, Wild True Sources, and existence around him began to fold and collapse in a terrifying manner, threatening to bring down all Complexity!
For the first time in a while, he felt a threat.
He felt his Moderate Complexity and Quasi-High Purity here in danger!
He prepared to exert even more power and even call his other True Sources here, when in the next moment...
WHOOSH!
Ash began to spread around him as a man surrounded by endless ash appeared.
WAA!
The Mythic True Signature of the Great Beyonder released trillions of obsidian-gold runes around him.
Veyl'Aethra radiated a wonder of white as his left hand trembled.
And around him, the terrific collapse seeking to pressure his existence itself was forcefully paused, with an erupting gray sea of ash even pushing it away!
"And here I thought there was still honor in Dead Things..."
The voice of the Holder of the True Source of Asche rang out as he stood before Noah, the Great Beyonder, and Veyl'Aethra.
The scene cleared.

In the region where Veltraxis was, the entire Domus had changed—as if everything nearby had collapsed and filled with paradoxes. Extreme obsidian foldings spread out, resembling the Nullvein Gravewake Folds!
Within them, the figures of the Dead Things became even more empowered. The power they radiated seemed twice as potent.
In front of all this, Veltraxis stood, his smiling expression never fading.
He floated toward the spot where M'gorrhaal, The Crawling Colossus, once stood. His obsidian-clawed hand reached out and tapped the area, as if struck by remembrance.
And his aged voice echoed out.
"He returns to the everlasting silence between pulses, where no weavings dare shimmer and all hungers are finally still. Let his rot sing with glory, for even decay remembers greatness."
Was he... honoring the decimation of M'gorrhaal?
Afterward, he turned to look toward the direction of Noah.
His gaze bypassed even the ancient figure surrounded by gray ash.

"Honor? Honor? Is that tasty? Can I wipe my arse with it? You see, when you are a Dead Thing, you have to be adaptable. You have to be like... what was that saying? Ah yes, you have to be like water, my friend."
HUUM!
"And I am a very constantly changing stream of water at this moment. I have to adapt."
His complexity was terrifying.
Even though it was deemed... High, it was terrifyingly so.

He alone had done something unfathomable—as this Gateway Domus was no longer simply filled with Wild True Sources... but the weavings of the Nullvein Gravewake Folds themselves had been inserted here by Veltraxis!
The Smiling Empty Maw shook his head as he looked toward Noah with eyes pulsing with obsidian death and continued.
"The one whose True Source you just collapsed... do you know what he was asking me just moments ago before we arrived?"

"He was asking me whether we should alert and let the other Mawbearers of the Hollow Concord of Nullity know what we were doing—and whether we needed support. I told him no. Because if there was a clue to that which so many of us seek, I wanted it for myself. And if there was no clue, I would've simply feasted on the weavings of a living Wheel of Existence. But now... to honor him, my mind has changed."
WAA!
Noah's expression became stern.
The Holder of the True Source of Asche's calm smile faded away entirely as he began to move, a massive Mythic True Signature of himself blooming above him!

"Haha, I've already done it. I've alerted all 100 Mawbearers of the Hollow Concord of Nullity about a possible Wheel of Existence I may want support on. Your location—unalterable across the Nullvein Gravewake Folds—is now known to all. And I do this not because I believe I cannot wipe you all here... but out of an overabundance of caution and efficiency. I am old. Truly old, and I have seen many things."

"Did you expect fairness? Did you expect that after asking for a one-versus-one battle and then destroying a Converged Architect, I'd be dismayed—have my pride hurt—and send another Converged Architect one after another? No. No, no, no!"
His eyes and weavings brimmed with death and madness.
"No."
Around him, the terrifying weavings of the Nullvein Gravewake Folds continued to spread!

"No... this is not a fairytale. This is not some fantasy. This is real. Too many things are at stake—and you don't even have the capacity to understand what existence for Dead Things is like. Today, you'll get a glimpse of how that feels. A glimpse of pain. A glimpse of death."
BOOM!
Countless weavings collapsed all around as this entire Gateway Domus became filled with the weavings of the Nullvein Gravewake Folds!
And Veltraxis looked coldly at the four of them.
The Great Beyonder was ashen, her eyes trembling with rage and horror.
Veyl'Aethra sighed, his gaze one of desolation.
And the Holder of the True Source of Asche sighed with ageless solemnity.
Things... seemed utterly dire.
The Smiling Empty Maw's outstretched smile became even more jagged as he continued.

"It seems all available Mawbearers of the Hollow Concord of Nullity who aren't tied up by other Wheels will be here soon. Tell me—has your Wheel of Existence not undergone multiple Breakings already? How many Resplendent Monads and Converged Architects does it have? Because unless you've dozens... things do not look well for you."
Its words were taunting.
"Oh, and speaking of which..."
And as if things couldn't possibly get worse...
"It seems the first one has arrived."
Veltraxis looked behind him- and in the next moment, the folded, collapsed weavings of paradoxes, existence, and nonexistence erupted as brand new auras of... 26 Dead Things bloomed.
Half Converged Architects. Half Harmonized Sourcebound Icons.
And in the lead...
"Haha, my brother—the 63rd Mawbearer of Endless Paradox—is the first to arrive, it seems."
At the forefront, a terrifying entity led the group of 26 newly arriving Dead Things. It radiated a level of Complexity eclipsing even the 77th Mawbearer of Recursive Hunger, Veltraxis!
It was an unfolding of existence that spelled doom and decimation.
Weavings that caused Noah's eyes to burn with tyrannical lividity!

Its words were taunting.
"Oh, and speaking of which..."
And as if things couldn't possibly get worse...
"It seems the first one has arrived."
Veltraxis looked behind him- and in the next moment, the folded, collapsed weavings of paradoxes, existence, and nonexistence erupted as brand new auras of...
26 Dead Things bloomed.
Half Converged Architects.
Half Harmonized Sourcebound Icons.
And in the lead...
"Haha, my brother—the 63rd Mawbearer of Endless Paradox—is the first to arrive, it seems."
At the forefront, a terrifying entity led the group of 26 newly arriving Dead Things.
It radiated a level of Complexity eclipsing even the 77th Mawbearer of Recursive Hunger, Veltraxis!
It was an unfolding of existence that spelled doom and decimation.
Weavings that caused Noah's eyes to burn with tyrannical lividity!

chapters.title: Chapter 3697: Everything I
paragraphs: At a certain point in time, one simply wanted to be left alone.
To do what they wished and accomplish what they wanted, without having to worry about large-scale events.
At this moment, that was what Noah desired.

He wanted to complete his Atlas of Existence, to let Ruination consume as many shattered pieces of the Wheel as she pleased, and for his Infiniverse Megalos to smoothly continue its transformation—becoming the Infiniverse Wheel of Existence.
He wanted all of this, but as always, there was the factor of Time.
And it seemed that with every passing moment, Time only spelled complexity and catastrophe.

The catastrophe right now? It stemmed from the arrival of a terrifying group of Dead Things, drawn here by a single being-Vha'Nekrul, who had observed Noah while the white flames of the True Source of the Singed empowered others.
Because of this, a monstrous entity had been alerted. Veltraxis, the Smiling Empty Maw, the 77th Mawbearer of Recursive Hunger.
And such a being, already beyond unfathomable, had called upon more like it. Others even more powerful had already begun to arrive. And they would keep arriving!
One after another.
One. After. Another!
At a time like this, when tyrannical lividity coursed through him, Noah instead found himself calm. Unfathomably calm. Eyes closed, calculating.
He took a breath, closed his eyes for a heartbeat. When he opened them again... they pulsed with clarity, as he sent a thought to the Infiniverse Megalos.
'The future that may unfold from here will be a difficult one. I need you to begin preparations just in case.'
He saw several possibilities.

He examined the complexity of the enemies before him and those to come, and compared them to his own evolving Complexity and Purity. He measured his potential once the Atlas was complete and as the Infiniverse Megalos continued forming Spokes of the Wheel.
He calculated. He judged. And the conclusions were... not ideal!
Because of this, he had to prepare.
|What do you need me to do, Master?|
The Infiniverse Megalos responded with her usual calm, measured tone.
Noah answered succinctly, even as the form of the 63rd Mawbearer of Endless Paradox began to materialize.
'Other parts of me will move with you. Start the process—traverse from Frequency to Frequency. Convert all Channelers to connect with you. The goal is all Frequencies and all possibilities.'
A heavy step.
And if one considered why Noah would begin such a process...they would dread the future he must have foreseen!
The Infiniverse Megalos didn't speak for a moment. Then, firmly.
|Understood, Master.|
A command given. A command followed.
Noah turned his gaze to the newly emerging figure- a thing of death, like all the others, but this one drew the attention of even Veltraxis.
The 63rd Mawbearer of Endless Paradox.
Veltraxis looked toward them as the new Mawbearer arrived, its form a massive obsidian bone-cross, an X-shaped skeleton of ruin with a crimson eye glaring at its center.
It was a vile thing to behold. And behind it, even more monstrosities appeared- each having reached the terrifying stage of Converged Architect.
|Oh 77th... This is the Wheel you found? Its taste already seems exquisite.|
"Haha, 63rd... Xhurrel. The Wheel itself will be interesting, yes. But the purity of a certain creature within this Wheel? That may be even more appetizing."
As he said this, Veltraxis turned a grim, ravenous smile toward Noah.
And even as they spoke, the surrounding weavings, still connected to the Infinite Ravines, trembled.
They had to tremble.
Because at this moment, Noah and everyone else could feel it.
The descent of a few dozen Wild True Sources of Existence.
A few dozen.
Enough to overwhelm even Harmonized Sourcebound Icons. Yet, it was... understandable.
Before Noah, the figure of the holder of the True Source of Asche sighed as he looked up.
"I didn't expect this day to come. All this time, I lingered, waited, did all that I could—hoping for a miracle. But like all things...it all turns to ash. Endless, unfathomable ash..."
His voice carried the weight of helplessness, even from one as powerful as a Resplendent Monad.
Noah looked up and confirmed it as well- multiple Gateway Domus were merging into theirs.
Continuously.
Without pause.
As if the Wheel of Existence had deemed it necessary to converge its defenses. Across many fractured doorways, a singular Gateway Domus was forming!
A unified... Infinite Ravines.
One doorway for the entire Wheel of Existence.
And that brought both wonder and dread.
Because from those fused gates...
HUUM!
Auras of power surged as defenders began to descend, their faces shocked.
They were numerous.
Dozens of beings at the level of Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity and the less complex Nascent Source-Bearer entities appeared from above, below, and behind.
Among them, Noah saw the figure of the Omnifather- his expression grave.
Apart from him, he also saw a woman!
He saw someone he had only glimpsed in the weavings of records, in dreams tied to Bob.
She stepped forth...the Watcher of the Wheelomachy.
The First Watcher. A radiant woman with flowing red hair that shimmered like molten dusk.
She stood beyond time's grasp, her eyes pulsing with a power close to that of a Resplendent Monad, her presence reflecting every revolution of the Infinite Wheel.
Noah squinted.
But as the Weaver of Existence, clarity came to him faster than to most as he was able to glimpse her True Source.
The True Source of Chronohedra- the very Axis of Temporal Balance!
A fearsome True Source. One that anchored reality while preserving the sequence of all positive time.
Among the defenders, she was among the purest, most intricate, and yet even she was not a true Resplendent Monad.
Men. Women. Entities with no clear race or gender.
Noah counted 77 Legends.
Protectors only spoken of in whispers across Frequencies. Some remembered. Most forgotten.
The Great Beyonder studied them all and confirmed what they already feared.
"All of the Gateway Domus... are merging here..."
Yes.
One of the worst possible scenarios was unfolding. All defenders were gathered in one place.
At the same time, more Dead Things emerged—some from the very same gateways the defenders had guarded all this time.
And those Dead Things, arriving one by one, looked in awe at the blazing auras of Veltraxis and the 63rd Mawbearer of Endless Paradox.
At the same time, behind those two beings, within the folds of Nullvein Gravewake that Veltraxis conjured, a tremor ran through, and...eighteen more Dead Things appeared.
Led by yet another Mawbearer of the Hollow Concord of Nullity.
It felt like an endless incursion.
And despair began rising like a flood!

chapters.title: Chapter 3698: Everything II
paragraphs: Despair was rising like a flood, and this wasn't happening to just some weak entities with lesser complexity who did not have the capability to shift the scale of power... this was happening to beings who had lived for millions of years.
Because the scene they were witnessing was utterly horrendous to behold.
Just now, in this moment, there were quite literally dozens of Converged Architects who were Dead Things.
Even without mentioning or acknowledging the Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity Dead Things.
The Converged Architects alone were equivalent to Resplendent Monads, and on the side of the Living, they had... a single one so far.
A few with extremely Pure or uniquely complex weavings were somewhat close to Resplendent Monads, but they could be counted on a single hand.
"What in fresh hell is this, my friend?"
From above the merging Gateway Domus, the figure of none other than the Origin Singed appeared, of course controlled by the mind of the Great Usurper.
He had just recently delved into the Infinite Ravines, and in this moment, he was already drawn into a singular, unified doorway, where he now stared at a number of terrifying entities.
The only one he recognized was Noah. And so he moved toward him, while the other arriving legends also gathered near the Holder of the True Source of Asche.
Near the only Resplendent Monad here.

Noah gave the Great Usurper a glance and shook his head as if even words could not explain this, continuing to survey the gathering legends. His gaze landed on a woman clad in weavings of Anti-Matter and Dark Matter, her eyes serpentine- was this... the Stellar Weaver?
The question lingered only a moment before another familiar presence stepped forward.
The Omnifather, though ashen, recognized Noah and came forward to ask.
"You... you were in the weavings of the Wheel. Do you know what Bob did within? Are these Dead Things his doing—invited by him after he left for the Nullvein Gravewake Folds?!"
The Omnifather looked injured as he echoed the question.
Noah gave him a glance and calmly replied,
"The chaos Bob caused has been dealt with as these Dead Things...have nothing to do with him."
They had nothing to do with him. But they were here.

They had caused the entire Wheel of Existence to exert its effort, merging every single doorway within the Infinite Ravines. The entire Wheel could now only be accessed through a singular, central focus point.
All defenders were present, and any Living Things that still existed would arrive here too.
The positives and negatives swirled. Even as the descent of a few dozen True Sources continued, the arrival of Dead Things never ceased. After the appearance of three Mawbearers...
BOOM!
Another shattered the folds of collapse and complexity as they appeared.
The 71st Mawbearer.
The 50th Mawbearer.
The 47th Mawbearer.
The 88th Mawbearer!

Noah looked from one to the next, watching them appear in seconds, each leading groups with at least twelve Dead Things, some as many as twenty-seven as his distinction as the Weaver of Existence continued to go crazy!
The more that appeared, the heavier the despair settled into the hearts of the Living who stood opposite them.
And all the while, Veltraxis stood at the forefront, his demonic grin, already stretched from ear to ear, somehow growing wider.
He was looking at Noah and the Holder of the True Source of Asche as if waiting.
Waiting for that face.
That face of despair.
That face of rage and pain.
And yet, even as the expressions of the living legends behind Noah became ashen... Noah remained calm.
His eyes did not so much as flutter.
Veltraxis took that as a challenge.
From the side of the Living...
"Haha... Haha! Just... Haha!"
Veyl'Aethra, the old man, was laughing madly.
His left hand flickered, trembling as it began to phase in and out of existence, as if it were lagging.
His Fractal Collapse... now visible. Everyone around him stepped back slightly.
Some didn't care. Their eyes showed only tiredness and waves of hopelessness as they looked up- not at the Dead Things, but beyond them.
An entity in the form of a massive white spider, seas of Anti-Matter surging around her, the True Source of Nihilos itself pulsing at her core, looked toward the distant dead with a despotic tone.

"We defended for eons. We left everything behind to battle Dead Things that at least matched us in strength—or were weaker. Through them, we grew stronger. We hoped for a distant future where none of this would be needed. And yet, the final result..."
She didn't finish.

Holding only Nascent Source-Bearer Complexity, her voice still carried a hopeless weight. Even existing in this chaotic space—layered with multiple Wild True Sources, took everything she had. And still... ash was spreading, forming a sea around them. It was the only bastion protecting the weaker defenders here, preventing their weavings from collapsing entirely under the pressure.
No one answered the hopelessness in the White Spider's voice.
Because what was there to say?
Beside Noah, the Great Beyonder had tears streaming down her face.
Not because she was weak. She was strong. And because she would keep fighting, that was why she cried. She wept wondering if it would all end like this- if all of it had ever truly meant something.
And then...
BOOM!
Behind them, an illusion of a radiant white-gold wheel bloomed to life.
From it, an entity with a golden blindfold stepped out.
An entity that could not see.
The Witness.

Even with the blindfold, desolation and sadness emanated from him. His very presence stabilized the wild True Sources, their terrifying effects suddenly drawn inward—focused on the region of collapsed paradoxes and existence where the Dead Things had gathered.
But his appearance was more than just symbolic!
Two Resplendent Monads now stood by their side.
And further behind them, many turned toward the illusory brilliance of the white-gold Wheel of Existence.
They saw the massive flow that had led them all here. And in this moment, when their eyes met it, the gazes of many were not filled with warmth.
They held grief. Even fury.
Some had left the Infinite Ravines long ago.
They had abandoned it.
But not them!
They still stood to defend it as now, a little less than one hundred Defenders of the Wheel remained here.
And yet—what reward did they earn for their loyalty?
Their only recompense was legions of powerful Dead Things appearing one after another in this sealed space.
"What do you think, O Bearer of the White-Gold Flame?"
The voice sliced through the hopelessness, Veltraxis speaking directly.
He looked toward Noah, his dead smile widening, his obsidian hands brimming with decay and death as he raised them, roaring with malicious laughter.

"There are already sixteen Mawbearers here and one hundred forty-three Converged Architects! Meanwhile, you have two flimsy Resplendent Monads to our 143! Tell me, what outcome do you think will bloom from all this?!"
HUUM!
His voice echoed, piercing and heavy. He wanted it.
He wanted that look of hopelessness and despair that had claimed so many faces among the Living.
But most of all, he wanted to see it on Noah.
But he...would never see it.
Because even now, in this woven storm of despair- where even defenders of the Wheel wept and faltered...Noah grasped a Spoke and replied, utterly void of emotion.
"The more of you that come, the more of you there are to kill."
Despair never touched Noah's face.
And he had no intention of letting it.
Because in this very moment...
He continued his preparations!

chapters.title: Chapter 3699: Everything III
paragraphs: As Noah made his preparations, so did others.
In a unique mental frequency of existence utilized by the Dead.
Folds of collapse and dead True Sources scattered here and there, in such a unique space where only the signatures of certain Dead Things could enter...
"Veltraxis, why call us in here?"
The voice of the 63rd Mawbearer of Endless Paradox called out toward the horrific figure of Veltraxis, who wore a wide smile on his face.
Around them, the other Mawbearers that had also arrived stood watchful, as Veltraxis looked at them all before he began to speak in an eerie tone.
"I want you all to keep a lookout and focus on this being right here..."
As he spoke, he waved the weavings of the dead around them, displaying the image of none other than Noah.

"This is the Living who drew me here in the first place. He held a True Source of Existence that could empower others. I know, that's nothing too crazy. We've seen it once or twice before. And when we investigated those Wheels of Existence, only a single one had anything that related to the Loom. So I came to check this one out—and this Living creature, who I can affirm is at the level of a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon, had a battle against M'gorrhaal, and was able to collapse his weavings in one shot."
The words raised the brows of the terrifyingly powerful and Complex Mawbearers.
Meanwhile, the horrid smile of Veltraxis only grew wider and darker.

"A Harmonized Sourcebound Icon who not only holds a True Source that empowers others, but can also skip past the staunch demarcations of Purity and Complexity to erupt with a power that can erase the weavings of a Converged Architect. Given that we are weaker in these Infinite Ravines, I'll give him a break, but still..."
He seemed to be indicating something.
And as if the others already knew what he meant, the 81st Mawbearer, a creature made entirely of muscular tissue, spoke out in a rumble.
"You don't mean to say... he is one of the True Favored Living Things?"
A True Favored Living Thing.

A creature born within the weavings of the Wheel, as inside their Existence, a mutation occurred and they gained a tremendous amount of weavings from the collective essence of the Breakings of the Wheel!
Such beings were akin to tonics to Dead Things as even a single one exceeded the value of thousands of Sorrowglass True Source Panaceas.
But they were always tricky.
And they were powerful.
Veltraxis only smiled deeper, shaking his head and raising his hands as if he could not be sure.

"Who knows? But any True Favored Living Thing from a Wheel indicates even more that the Wheel holds something special. Watch his weavings closely from here on out. If he can kill one Converged Architect in a single blow—even though I have begun bringing in the dreaded Nullvein Gravewake Folds—he may suddenly display power to kill multiple Converged Architects. All I ask for bringing you all here... is one fourth of him and this Wheel."
He was bargaining.

"Oh, and to ensure there is no chance of failure, I'll continue to call a few other Mawbearers—we know how tricky True Favored Living Things can be, where they can turn the tides even in impossible odds. Right now, their chances of withstanding us are less than 1%, and I want to bring that to 0 if I can. Even if it's overkill—but it will mean what you all can devour will be less. This, I apologize for."
The 63rd Mawbearer of Endless Paradox waved his hand at this.
"It is okay. If the Wheel also ends up having something relating to the Loom, it will be well worth it in the end. Alright—how do you all want to do it?"
How did they want to do it?
What exactly did he mean by such a thing?
Even though others might not know or understand, the Mawbearers of the Hollow Concord of Nullity knew very well.
Veltraxis smiled while looking at the others as he voiced out.

"I was thinking... the Symphony of the True Dead. The resonance of all our Dead True Sources permeating out will take out any Harmonized Sourcebound Icons, and only the Resplendent Monads and the True Favored Living Thing would be able to withstand it—though heavily bound. And of course, the one to lead it is just arriving... I greet thee."
Veltraxis bowed toward a newly arriving figure in this mental frequency.
It was... a humanoid entity in his early 30s, neither handsome nor ugly, but surrounded by musical instruments.
"I greet thee, O 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo, Melodrass. We are humbled that you answered our call to come, when we know you are attending to multiple things."
Veltraxis and all other Mawbearers bowed toward the newly arriving being.
The 9th!
A Single-Numbered Mawbearer!
Veltraxis and the others were already unfathomably complex—but this being... his weavings had already begun to surpass the level of a Converged Architect.
Better yet, he was also a Resplendent Monad as unlike many Dead Things, he had managed to bring his Purity to a high level!
A nigh impossible task for the Dead!
But his Complexity... was already nearing the level far past High, as he was simply looking for that spark.
"With you here, we may not even need to do anything."
Another Mawbearer smiled as he said this while rising up.
The 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo did not say anything—he only smiled while shaking his head.
He did not speak.
As if he could not speak!
Veltraxis shook his head, as if he understood everything from just that head shake, and he was the one to reply.

"We have to be methodical with any Wheel of Existence. Anything forced to death will fight like mad—to the extent that its last flare of death could eradicate any Resplendent Monad or Converged Architect. We don't want that to be any of us, right? The last time a Mawbearer truly died was a billion years ago—let's not change that too soon..."
His deep voice echoed out as the others agreed.
Just like this, the Dead Things convened and got ready to unleash decimation!

Noah looked out toward the eyes of the Dead that were seeking dread and despair—especially the cruel figure of Veltraxis, who seemed ready to move at any moment, and the ever-increasing numbers of Mawbearers coming through!

He looked at all of this and began to move with more and more certainty—as right away, he raised his hands and released flickers of white-gold flames that looked like small, glorious, spinning, flaming Omniverses.
They bloomed to cover multiple areas all around him while he voiced out to the Legends here.
"The white-gold flames around you will empower your True Source should you accept them. They will make you even purer and allow you to express grander complexity."
He spoke in a calm tone and described everything slowly.
And yet—even after he spoke—one of the Legends turned to look at him and shook their head.

"What use will it be? Their Converged Architects grow more and more in number with every passing second. Unless, behind me, the weavings of the Wheel of Existence have so drastically changed that Resplendent Monads are going to rise out by the dozens soon—I ask you again, how the fuck does this change anything?!"
And the Legend was nearly shouting as he said this.
It was an entity with the True Source of Pride.
His body shone black and gold, and in this moment, its very construct seemed to be breaking as its core Source shook!

In the midst of his negativity—which could not really be dismissed, because it was true, the figure of the Holder of the True Source of Asche reached out to grasp the dazzling white-gold flame in front of him as his voice echoed out.
"So long as we are alive, there is always use in fighting."
