chapters.title: Chapter 3700: Everything IV
paragraphs: So long as they were alive, there was always use in fighting!
The Holder of the True Source of Asche grasped Noah's white-gold flames as they came to bathe his body entirely, the ash surrounding him becoming even more radiant and pure!
A gray sea of ash exploded from him with terrifying intensity as he continued.

"I have gone by many names, but I have been here since the Eighth Breaking of the Wheel. You all can call me Arthur, the Sea of Ash. And if I were you, I would grab that bundle of white-gold flames to empower yourself, even if it's only slightly against what we face."
His words rang out like something unfathomable, undeniable, and absolute.
And many Living Legends looked at one another before, one by one, they began to reach out toward the radiant white-gold flames.
The Great Beyonder and the Great Usurper had long since taken hold of these white-gold flames the moment they appeared, the latter looking toward Noah as he voiced out:

"I would ask how your True Source is capable of empowering as many Nascent Source-Bearers, Harmonized Sourcebound Icons, and Resplendent Monads as you wish, but I believe it's better not to ask. As always... fights with you are grand ones. But even I... do not know about this one today."
The words were whispered, only to Noah. He alone heard them. He alone understood them.
And he knew they were true—because even the Great Usurper was uncertain of what was coming.
But just because they were doubtful didn't mean they couldn't try.

In a short period of time, all of the Living Legends had their bodies bathed in white-gold flames, their eyes showing varying levels of shock amidst the seriousness as they gave Noah sidelong glances.
The First Watcher of the Wheelomachy floated toward the Witness, who came in near Arthur, the Sea of Ash, as she asked:
"How do we fight this?"
She asked for guidance from those older than her.
She asked the Witness—who came with the allure of the white-gold Wheel that stood radiant even now behind them, making them bask in a warm glow that reminded them they were not alone in this!
And yet the blindfolded Witness only looked ahead at the Dead Things while remaining quiet, his mouth moving to utter a few words that nobody knew who they were directed to.
|She promised.|
HUUM!
She promised.
Who promised? What did they promise?
The Wheel of Existence? Or someone else?

Many were confounded by those cryptic words, but Noah knew exactly what the Witness was referring to—and it was none other than the words of the Infiniverse to the Wheel of Existence: that she would help it through its next transformation!
But... things had changed so drastically fast that it was unknown what would become of that promise.
"Get ready."

Arthur, the Sea of Ash, voiced out as above him, the mightiest Mythic True Signature of Asche he had ever unleashed bloomed—his senses, as one of the most powerful here, telling him the Dead Things were about to move!
At the cusp of a truly heavy battle.
In the budding Infiniverse Wheel of Existence.
Near the massive Spoke of Entropy.
Massive, illusory versions of Noah floated grandly as if they were Quasi-Mythic True Signatures, observing the advancements while convening a Council in these perilous times.
A body the size of an Omniverse wreathed in white-gold flames could be seen, representing the True Source of the Singed.
A stellar obsidian illusory body stood with gravitas and wonder, representing the True Source of Existence.
Ruination, Runes, and Entropy were also there—as in another moment...
BOOM!
A white-green Signature of Noah bloomed—it was... Continuity!
|The Second Spoke of Existence has bloomed.|
|The True Source of Continuity, sitting at Quasi-High Purity and Moderate Complexity, has been born.|

Bountiful waves of information began to arrive, but Noah ignored them. After the massive white-gold Spoke formed to connect to the illusory ring of the newly forming Wheel, the Infiniverse Megalos was already proceeding ahead as...
|The Living Absolute Complex True Frequency of Manadynamics has begun its formation.|
A radiant blue gushed out.
Mana.
A significant part of Noah.
A major part of Noah!
But...
"It will not be enough."
Of the Council of Noahs gathered, the True Source of Existence spoke out with regality and wonder, stating the truth.
Many parts of him knew it!
The True Source of Continuity, newly formed and learning about its terrifying weavings, looked toward Existence before it replied in agreement.
"All appearing enemies have been selected as targets under True Severed Adaptive Power of Existence. Our Complexity is rising faster than ever before, but still... it will not be enough."
WAA!
The words were neither despairing nor angry—they only stated the facts!

As the Weaver of Existence, he had read the unfathomably High Complexity of the Dead Things—the Mawbearers especially. Even if he became a genuine Resplendent Monad in multiple True Sources, he would only be able to match and, over time, take down a single Mawbearer!
If it had only ever remained the 77th Mawbearer of Recursive Hunger, this is how everything would have played out.
But Veltraxis did not follow the script.
He rapidly and instantly called many more like him.
So...
"We can only forge ahead and do all that we can."
The deep voice of the Singed boomed out as he waved his hands.
"All the refined Purity and Complexity within the Cradle of Purity... shall now go toward the Pathways of the True Sources of Quintessence, Infinity, Cheats, Paradox, and Protagonist."
WAA!
One heavy decision was made.
In the depths of Noah's being, anchored in the depths of the Infiniverse, magnificence began to flourish.
"Add one more."
The weavings of Existence perked up and stated.
"Take Kuklos to a True Source first, and complete the True Source Atlas of Existence. The budding System in the Last Mundi of Power shall be... Veritarch—the Truthborne Continuum."
HUUM!
A part of Noah made a grand declaration, and the others looked at one another and nodded with shining eyes.
His Atlas.
His Construct.
At this moment, the weavings of Dark Matter, Anti-Matter, and Matter that were circling within all came together to achieve a simple result.
A complex result.
Veritarch.
The Truthborne Continuum, as everything seemed to be leading to True, True, and True!
Veritas meant Truth, and Arche meant Origin.
This last System of Existence was what was meant to be the origin of what made Noah true.
The prior Mundis of Power represented a great deal of unique Complexity, but the last one... it was meant to transcend everything—as in its Finality, it was meant to reason and include all others.
It was meant to define and answer WHY certain weavings were allowed to be the way that they were!
BOOM!
And at this moment, after being designed and rejected again and again in the Last Mundi, it was given its identity as it came to be.
And it bathed itself with wonder.
Stellar verdant-blue brilliance bathed everything.
Green blue!
It bathed the other Mundis of Power with wonder.
It bathed the True Source Atlas of Existence with wonder.
It bathed... Everything.
Everything!

chapters.title: Chapter 3701: Everything V
paragraphs: Veritarch.
This System of Existence was being born—and alongside it came the completion of the grandest Project in Noah's Existence.
He felt like he had been building the Atlas of Existence for quite some time, and now...
|The Last System of Existence has been designed under the banner of the True Source Atlas of Existence.|
|Its completion foretells of glorious times and unfathomable grandiosity.|

|Alongside its completion, the True Source Atlas of Existence begins its transformation into the Absolute Complex Atlas Living Wheel, allowing the budding True Source of Kuklos feeding from the Cradle of Purity to design the Living Wheel, a type of Absolute Complex True Source.|
HUUM!
The Council of Noahs buzzed as they became that much brighter, and the entire region of the budding Infiniverse Wheel of Existence became covered by a multicolored wave of light!
Every single creature within this space felt it.
From the figure of Henry surrounded by Kazuhiko and others.
To the Sages, Yoo Jin, Emelline and Mysara who were brought back into the Infiniverse.
To the figure of the Queen of Matter with the Shadow Guard, Night.
To Barbatos and Adelaide and all the Queens of Infiniverse.
None of them had the entirety of the picture of what exactly was happening, as even Noah was finding out as time passed.
But they all felt the budding brilliance—they knew it was something truly significant.

His Infiniverse Megalos was transforming into the Infiniverse Wheel of Existence, and yet Noah took the first step—and a heavy step at that—as the completion of his Atlas prompted it to transform and become an Absolute Complex Living Wheel!
And such a wonder...
|All Systems of Existence contained within the budding Absolute Complex Atlas Living Wheel of Existence can be nothing else but True Sources.|

The first heavy and utterly terrifying possibility of this Living Wheel showed itself, as the first order of business was to take the 9 Systems of Power and elevate them from pathways to become True Sources!
Conceptual, Outerversal, Kuklos, Ingeniare, Singed, Megalos, Ordo Ab Chao, Eldritch Expanse, and Veritarch.
Those which were not True Sources surged to become ones at this moment.

Kuklos alone was radiating a terrifying allure of power, as it was transforming the Atlas in a manner that had multiple different-colored Spokes—each housing the weavings of the Systems of Existence inside the Atlas form.
The circular structure of the Atlas entirely became one of a Wheel.
A Living Wheel.
An Absolute Complex Atlas Living Wheel!
With it, the surge in Complexity and Purity was terrifying—as when it all came together under Noah... it was enough to cause tremendous changes.

|The Rim of the Living Wheel budding in your Existence contains the allure of Absolute Complex Living Paradox, granting it an unassailable Purpose as no Dead Things or Opposing Weavings of Existence are capable of devouring or disseminating your Weavings of Existence.|
The Living Wheel was just forming.
9 True Sources were flaring with it.
And yet...
It was already displaying such unfathomable wonder—and Noah could feel it.
And his distinction as the Weaver of Existence confirmed it!
|Your Complexity and Purity surge collectively from all the Complex and Pure True Sources you hold.|
|The upper cap of Quasi-High Purity and Moderate Complexity has been broken.|
|Due to the Purity and Complexity of all True Sources you hold, your Weavings of Existence stand gloriously at High Purity and High Complexity.|
|Both a Resplendent Monad and a Converged Architect.|
The Council of Noahs all radiated a terrifying pulse of wonder and complexity.
His existence felt unfathomably pure—and unfathomably complex—at the same time.
His weavings felt Boundless—as if they could do anything.

Others chased the stage he had just attained in an extremely short period of time. The legends he stood among in the Infinite Ravines had been stuck as Nascent Source-Bearer entities and Harmonized Sourcebound Icons for millions upon millions of years.
And how long had it taken him to go from opening his Eye of Existence...
To declaring his Ordinances.
To beginning to Sever his weavings.
How Long?!
Days.
Mere, fucking, days.
If any knew of this—they might just end themselves.
And as all of this unfolded...
|Your Living Wheel of Existence is blooming to full fruition.|
|The Countdown has begun.|
HUUM!
His weavings felt an exponential blast of Complexity and Purity as he received an ominous message.
The Countdown has begun.
"What Countdown?"
The True Source of Existence boomed out as it asked the Living Wheel forming within himself.
|A Countdown to a Transformation. These are the only weavings that have been discerned so far.|
A Transformation!
What... the green Wheel of Existence was seeking to do before the first Breaking of the Wheel?!

Noah became stern at such a finding, as he continued to grasp and understand the newly budding Living Wheel that was coming with a terrifying number of boons—what he had just experienced being only the tip of the iceberg.
Because...
|Your Origin, Body, and Soul are being prepared to take their place as the aspects of a Living Wheel of Existence.|
|Different Aspects and Sources within your Existence can begin forming True Frequencies of Existence within your Living Wheel and ensure smooth passage toward becoming True Sources.|
Yes.
The Living Wheel came with many things.
Many wonders!
But even then...
"Will it be enough?"
Noah asked himself—as in the next moment, his Purity and Complexity shot out!
In the Infinite Ravines.

At this moment, the side of the Living had two utterly massive Mythic True Signatures rising—one from Arthur, the Sea of Ash, and the other from the Witness... who unveiled an illusory verdant-gold wheel that was almost bent into an infinity symbol!
Almost.
Alongside them, the Great Beyonder erupted with her own Mythic True Signature—as she slightly surprised others!

Her Purity at this moment was making greater jumps due to what another part of her, connected to Noah in an Amarantos Dream, was experiencing all of a sudden, and due to the empowerment of the white-gold flames that just became more intense.
Not just for her—but for everyone!
Within the next few seconds, she would likely claim the stage of a Resplendent Monad fully.
But even in the midst of all this, the Dead Things ahead stirred—as the voice of the 77th Mawbearer of Recursive Hunger boomed out while a horrific aura arose from behind them.
"Give some damn respect for the one who utterly seals everything for you all. The 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo, MELODRASS!"
HUUM!
A humanoid figure came through as the Dead Things parted.
A figure that caused Arthur, the Sea of Ash, to instantly become ashen—as he looked out at the billowing waves of power with a sense of horror!
Their strongest Resplendent Monad...showed a face of shock and horror!
It looked like the final nail in the coffin, when all of a sudden...
"OOOOH"
DUM!
A symphony began to play.
Drums began to beat.
Noah's will bellowed out with waves of unfathomable Tyranny—and in the next moment... massive Mythic True Signatures of his began to appear!
But they did not manifest above him near the Living.

They bloomed gloriously around the distant Dead Things, in their own turf—and yet they shone with untouchable glory as nine Mythic True Signatures, representing the power of a Resplendent Monad each, were the first ones to start a heavy, heavy battle!

He felt like he had been building the Atlas of Existence for quite some time, and now...
|The Last System of Existence has been designed under the banner of the True Source Atlas of Existence.|
|Its completion foretells of glorious times and unfathomable grandiosity.|

|Alongside its completion, the True Source Atlas of Existence begins its transformation into the Absolute Complex Atlas Living Wheel, allowing the budding True Source of Kuklos feeding from the Cradle of Purity to design the Living Wheel, a type of Absolute Complex True Source.|
HUUM!

To the figure of the Queen of Matter with the Shadow Guard, Night.
To Barbatos and Adelaide and all the Queens of Infiniverse.

Conceptual, Outerversal, Kuklos, Ingeniare, Singed, Megalos, Ordo Ab Chao, Eldritch Expanse, and Veritarch.
Those which were not True Sources surged to become ones at this moment.

The circular structure of the Atlas entirely became one of a Wheel.
A Living Wheel.
An Absolute Complex Atlas Living Wheel!
With it, the surge in Complexity and Purity was terrifying—as when it all came together under Noah... it was enough to cause tremendous changes.

9 True Sources were flaring with it.
And yet...
It was already displaying such unfathomable wonder—and Noah could feel it.
And his distinction as the Weaver of Existence confirmed it!

The Council of Noahs all radiated a terrifying pulse of wonder and complexity.
His existence felt unfathomably pure—and unfathomably complex—at the same time.
His weavings felt Boundless—as if they could do anything.
Others chased the stage he had just attained in an extremely short period of time.
The legends he stood among in the Infinite Ravines had been stuck as Nascent Source-Bearer entities and Harmonized Sourcebound Icons for millions upon millions of years.
And how long had it taken him to go from opening his Eye of Existence...
To declaring his Ordinances.
To beginning to Sever his weavings.
How Long?!
Days.

chapters.title: Chapter 3702: Everything VI
paragraphs: Vibrant.
That was the one word that could describe exactly what was happening right now, as one Mythic True Signature after another emerged within the folds of collapse and nonexistence.
And the fantastical part? They were unaffected by the weavings of collapse and death- standing unaltered, as though they would remain so for all existence.
One was a Mythic True Signature clearly forming Noah's body, sculpted from trillions of golden runes. Another showed a figure entirely crimson, radiating an endless light of Ruin.
Another displayed a dazzling frame- a Wheel of Existence spinning furiously, dozens of massive spokes shooting outward, latching onto multiple Converged Architects.
There were many. And each one was undoubtedly pristine and vivid, as if the identity behind each Mythic True Signature was being carved into reality for all to see.

They expressed their True Sources with wild abandon, even under the influence of Dead Things- each demonstrating staggering levels of High Purity and Complexity. When they thundered down against the Converged Architects... they overwhelmed multiple Dead True Sources.
BOOM! BOOM!
One massive Dead Thing, a Converged Architect, was flooded by a sea of golden runes. Trillions etched themselves onto its frame before golden tendrils dragged it away, unseen.
Another Dead Thing had its True Source fall into an endless cycle of Ruin. So sudden was the descent that its core collapsed instantly in a fractal explosion, blooming seas of bones.
One after another, approximately seventeen Converged Architects of the Dead Things were struck by the radiant Mythic True Signatures.
Some collapsed, beginning to fracture. Others were torn asunder by tyrannical golden tendrils of light, pulled toward a Cradle of Purity.
By the time the Mawbearers reacted... thirteen of those seventeen Converged Architects had fallen.
And yet...
"Haha! Did I not tell you all to expect this? But even this exceeds my wildest dreams!"
Veltraxis, the Smiling Empty Maw, exploded with power. A massive, intricate Mythic True Signature of Death erupted from him, standing to oppose three of Noah's Signatures.
The True Sources of Runes, Ruination, and Kuklos were all held back by a terrifying skeletal head wearing a bony smile stretched ear to ear.

Its sockets beamed with a devouring light- consuming everything, or trying to. Noah's changing True Sources- these it could not devour, the weavings of existence nearby, even the collapse and uncertainty of the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
Veltraxis alone clashed against three of Noah's Mythic True Signatures- each representing a Monad.
It was an astonishing sight- a testament to his staggering complexity.
And his grin only widened. He turned his head slowly, observing all the Mythic True Signatures unbothered by the Dead Weavings surrounding them.
Even though multiple Converged Architects had collapsed from Noah's assault.
Even though behind him, the Great Beyonder and other defenders flickered with renewed hope at the display of power.
One Resplendent Monad, however, did not share that hope. He still wore a face of horror.
It was Arthur- the Sea of Ash.
As if he could see something others could not.
His expression twisted as he watched the singular Dead Thing Veltraxis had introduced: the 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo, Melodrass.
Noah's weavings locked onto the same being.

The moment Melodrass appeared, alarm bells rang within the depths of Noah's existence. He sought to understand just how terrifying a single numbered Mawbearer of the Hollow Concord of Nullity could be.
His Mythic True Signature of Eldritch Expanse, a mass of countless black and white strings, reached out toward the being.
And then...
A chord echoed.
A Chord.
TRIING!
This being, a middle-aged humanoid so subtle in appearance that one might second-guess whether he was truly a Dead Thing...played an instrument.
The chord of a guitar rang out.
And in that moment, Noah felt his surging Weavings of True Sources, on the verge of unleashing unimaginable brilliance, become suppressed.
Restricted.
Immovable.
His Mythic True Signatures... which had just annihilated over a dozen Converged Architects... were rendered frozen.
The expression of his physical body near the Great Beyonder and the Great Usurper became severe. He spoke immediately, firm and commanding.
"Stop. Do not resist."
White-gold flames burst from him, shining with the light of displacement.
He sought to pull them away.
Because as the Weaver of Existence standing close to this so-called 9th Mawbearer, Melodrass, Noah had managed to analyze him, however briefly.
If the other Mawbearers were power incarnate, analogous to soldiers wielding devastating guns...
Then Melodrass...was a commander with nuclear weapons all around.
The difference was that dramatic.
The Great Beyonder heard Noah's call and was stunned.
She had just witnessed him unleash multiple Mythic True Signatures- ready to turn the tide of battle, to lay waste to the Dead.
Why the sudden retreat?
Her weavings twisted toward him. And she saw...
His gaze- more serious than she had ever seen it.
No smile. No detached calm.
Only an overwhelming finality that broke her heart.
She closed her eyes. She didn't understand- but she didn't resist. She allowed his weavings to envelop her, her True Source pulled into him before being shuttled inward toward the Wheel.
Noah turned to do the same for the Great Usurper when...
TRIING!
Another chord.
The first had immobilized Noah's Mythic True Signatures.
The second... rippled outward as an undeniable wave of death.
It spread everywhere.
Too complex.
Too advanced in the intricacies of True Sources for even Noah to fully decipher.
That one chord... was utterly devastating.
Because after it...
Silence.
No weavings stirred.
An immense, suffocating silence fell, muting even Veltraxis's cruel laughter.
The drums and symphonies once playing for Noah vanished.
In that stillness, Noah saw Arthur, the Sea of Ash- kneeling, livid, and gold-gray ash-blood bleeding from his forehead.
Beside him, the Witness's blindfold had nearly torn away, his body faintly glowing with weak golden light.
And they were the lucky ones.
Noah turned to the Living Legends.
They...
They had half their bodies missing- disintegrating alongside their True Sources as though they had heard a melody beyond comprehension.
Half were no longer conscious. Their True Sources breaking down.
The others were gravely wounded- staring ahead in utter horror.
At the one thing that had done this with just a single chord.
At the Dead Thing.
The 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo.
Melodrass.
An appearance that, once again, shattered the script of how things should be playing out for them!

chapters.title: Chapter 3703: Everything VII
paragraphs: There was immense silence in the last doorway of the Infinite Ravines.
The 9th Mawbearer did not speak, and yet, when his weavings exploded out, it was as if he deemed everyone else to be the same as him- no longer capable of making any sound at all.
He looked like nothing more than a man.
He did not have the same terrifying appearance of a Dead Thing. He didn't radiate endless malice and horror.
He simply emanated silence and death.

A presence that utterly changed the state of the battle. When Noah looked at the Living Legends, the body of the Origin Singed that the Great Usurper occupied... half of it was decimated and torn, the other half decaying.

The remaining eye of the Great Usurper looked utterly shocked, unable to stop staring at the Dead Thing surrounded by instruments who now gently tugged at the strings of a guitar with tremendous interest.
A being that did not speak even now. Within the depths of Noah's weavings, the voice of the Infiniverse Megalos echoed out.

|I have already accelerated the preparations, Master. One-eighth of all probable Frequencies of Existence of the Wheel have had their Channelers change their Source. I have even preemptively begun their relocation into the budding Spokes of the Infiniverse. I have already sent a body back to the core of the Wheel of Existence itself as I will continue the preparations.|
Preparations.
They were being made for a reason.
In case of the worst possible scenario which, for some reason, seemed more and more like an inevitability.
Noah realized and knew full well at this moment that he had met an enemy the current him could not yet overcome.
And when he considered the current him, he was also considering the version of himself a few seconds from now or even a few hours from now as his Living Wheel became more structured.
He considered his unique abilities.
He considered Cheats.
He considered his own stupendous Quintessential League of Existence.
And still, even with all of these considerations...
The type of complexity that appeared atop the Mawbearers already here had simply eclipsed everything.

And he knew this better than anyone else. His Mythic True Signatures were right in front of the Dead Things and currently bound within the surrounding weavings of existence by the power of that very being.
Apart from binding him, that entity had even tried to disperse and devour his radiant True Sources. But of course, there was one prompt that had denied all of this.

|The Rim of the Living Wheel budding in your Existence contains the allure of Absolute Complex Living Paradox, granting it an unassailable Purpose as no Dead Things or Opposing Weavings of Existence are capable of devouring or disseminating your Weavings of Existence.|
They could not devour him.
They could not disperse his weavings.
The most they could do was bind him down, and that was momentary.
At this moment.
After that single devastating attack and the silence it carried, the figure of Veltraxis bowed to the 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo as if asking for permission to speak in this silence.
But Noah...
HUUM!
|The True Source of Quintessence is budding from the purified Purity and Complexity stemming from the Cradle of Purity.|
Noah did not need to be granted permission to express his Will in this space.
If others opened their mouths, they would find themselves unable to make a single sound echo out at this moment.
But Noah...
Colorless brilliance filled him.
Quintessence filled him!
And...
"I advise you not to proceed with this."
HUUM!
He spoke with brilliance and calmness, a tone of grandeur echoing as his voice rang out- actually shocking Veltraxis, who seemed to have just been granted voice in this space.
He stood beside the 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo, his smile stretched tightly.

"You continue to exceed all that I expected-to even be capable of speech in the face of the Dissonant Echo. Are these multiple fucking True Sources you're exhibiting? You alone, carrying the power of multiple Resplendent Monads, even though you should have been at Harmonized Sourcebound Icon just a moment ago? Haha. Had I kept it just myself here without calling the other Mawbearers, I may have been overpowered by you eventually. But this..."
Veltraxis waved his hand toward the throngs of Converged Architects.
At the Mawbearers who seemingly did not stop arriving, their numbers increasing even now.

"...This is why the Dead stick together. Why we move with caution, and do our best not to let our negative natures get the better of us. Because we know how obscene the Living can be. We were once the Living, after all!"
Veltraxis was already proclaiming victory, but Noah didn't look at him. His gaze shifted to the 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo, Melodrass, as he focused intently.
His voice echoed again.
"I advise you not to proceed with this."
A stern warning.
The Dead Thing surrounded by instruments had dark hair and eyes devoid of emotion. A dark overcoat cloaked his pale, unhealthy skin.
The only life around him seemed to be in his instruments, and now, he turned to gaze at Noah.
A gaze.
But Noah grew stern. Stellar obsidian brilliance of the True Source of Existence erupted, forming a massive Mythic True Signature around him as if he needed to summon it just to withstand that gaze!

With a single chord, Melodrass had halted Noah's rampant power. With another, he decimated more than half the defenders and gravely injured both the Resplendent Monads- the Witness and Arthur, and the Sea of Ash.
And now, others couldn't even voice a sound. A terrifying Dead True Source permeated everything, but the way it did so... was too complex for many to even comprehend.
A complexity far exceeding what Resplendent Monads or Converged Architects should be capable of.
That was the monster they were unlucky enough to encounter.

"You advise and advise... but do you truly think, after everything we've seen, that we'll just listen and pull back? Say, 'Oh well, this True Favored Living Thing has advised us—everybody, let's pack up and leave!' Is that... your expectation?"
The glee in Veltraxis was visible as he continued to speak.
The 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo still did not utter a word.
Noah's gaze lingered on this unfathomably powerful being as his weavings echoed again.

"I advise because what you choose next will determine whether, in the weeks and months to come... the Hollow Concord of Nullity still exists. Based on your choice, the names and weavings of the Mawbearers may either endure or be utterly erased across the folds of collapse and uncertainty."
His threat was unmistakable.

He made it clear- his weavings would persist even after all of this. And if they continued on this path... he would hunt them down one by one until even the Nullvein Gravewake Folds forgot their dead weavings.
The silence after Noah's words was deafening.
On this day, he faced a scenario he had always feared.
A situation where enemies far too powerful for his current self made their presence known.
And no matter how brilliant his weavings were now...
They could not rise fast enough to change the tide in time.
Yet even with his warning, the eyes of Melodrass remained cold- without emotion.
His hand rose, higher than before, to strike another chord.
Veltraxis smiled so wide it seemed his face would split in half as his voice echoed.
"We are already dead- seeking the singular thing that will act as our salvation. Do you think threats of death will deter us?"
His eyes burned with joy.
And beside him, the 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo finally spoke for the first time.
He spoke... three words, even as he struck a chord.
|Symphony of Death.|
HUUM!

The remaining eye of the Great Usurper looked utterly shocked, unable to stop staring at the Dead Thing surrounded by instruments who now gently tugged at the strings of a guitar with tremendous interest.
A being that did not speak even now.
Within the depths of Noah's weavings, the voice of the Infiniverse Megalos echoed out.
|I have already accelerated the preparations, Master.
One-eighth of all probable Frequencies of Existence of the Wheel have had their Channelers change their Source.
I have even preemptively begun their relocation into the budding Spokes of the Infiniverse.
I have already sent a body back to the core of the Wheel of Existence itself as I will continue the preparations.|
Preparations.
They were being made for a reason.
In case of the worst possible scenario which, for some reason, seemed more and more like an inevitability.
Noah realized and knew full well at this moment that he had met an enemy the current him could not yet overcome.
And when he considered the current him, he was also considering the version of himself a few seconds from now or even a few hours from now as his Living Wheel became more structured.
He considered his unique abilities.
He considered Cheats.
He considered his own stupendous Quintessential League of Existence.
And still, even with all of these considerations...
The type of complexity that appeared atop the Mawbearers already here had simply eclipsed everything.
And he knew this better than anyone else.
His Mythic True Signatures were right in front of the Dead Things and currently bound within the surrounding weavings of existence by the power of that very being.
Apart from binding him, that entity had even tried to disperse and devour his radiant True Sources.
But of course, there was one prompt that had denied all of this.

|The Rim of the Living Wheel budding in your Existence contains the allure of Absolute Complex Living Paradox, granting it an unassailable Purpose as no Dead Things or Opposing Weavings of Existence are capable of devouring or disseminating your Weavings of Existence.|
They could not devour him.
They could not disperse his weavings.
The most they could do was bind him down, and that was momentary.
At this moment.
After that single devastating attack and the silence it carried, the figure of Veltraxis bowed to the 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo as if asking for permission to speak in this silence.
But Noah...
HUUM!
|The True Source of Quintessence is budding from the purified Purity and Complexity stemming from the Cradle of Purity.|
Noah did not need to be granted permission to express his Will in this space.
If others opened their mouths, they would find themselves unable to make a single sound echo out at this moment.
But Noah...
Colorless brilliance filled him.
Quintessence filled him!
And...
"I advise you not to proceed with this."
HUUM!
He spoke with brilliance and calmness, a tone of grandeur echoing as his voice rang out- actually shocking Veltraxis, who seemed to have just been granted voice in this space.
He stood beside the 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo, his smile stretched tightly.
"You continue to exceed all that I expected-to even be capable of speech in the face of the Dissonant Echo.
Are these multiple fucking True Sources you're exhibiting?
You alone, carrying the power of multiple Resplendent Monads, even though you should have been at Harmonized Sourcebound Icon just a moment ago?
Haha.
Had I kept it just myself here without calling the other Mawbearers, I may have been overpowered by you eventually.
But this..."
Veltraxis waved his hand toward the throngs of Converged Architects.
At the Mawbearers who seemingly did not stop arriving, their numbers increasing even now.
"...This is why the Dead stick together.
Why we move with caution, and do our best not to let our negative natures get the better of us.
Because we know how obscene the Living can be.
We were once the Living, after all!"
Veltraxis was already proclaiming victory, but Noah didn't look at him.
His gaze shifted to the 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo, Melodrass, as he focused intently.
His voice echoed again.
"I advise you not to proceed with this."
A stern warning.
The Dead Thing surrounded by instruments had dark hair and eyes devoid of emotion.
A dark overcoat cloaked his pale, unhealthy skin.
The only life around him seemed to be in his instruments, and now, he turned to gaze at Noah.
A gaze.
But Noah grew stern.
Stellar obsidian brilliance of the True Source of Existence erupted, forming a massive Mythic True Signature around him as if he needed to summon it just to withstand that gaze!
With a single chord, Melodrass had halted Noah's rampant power.
With another, he decimated more than half the defenders and gravely injured both the Resplendent Monads- the Witness and Arthur, and the Sea of Ash.
And now, others couldn't even voice a sound.
A terrifying Dead True Source permeated everything, but the way it did so... was too complex for many to even comprehend.
A complexity far exceeding what Resplendent Monads or Converged Architects should be capable of.
That was the monster they were unlucky enough to encounter.
"You advise and advise... but do you truly think, after everything we've seen, that we'll just listen and pull back?
Say, 'Oh well, this True Favored Living Thing has advised us—everybody, let's pack up and leave!' Is that... your expectation?"
The glee in Veltraxis was visible as he continued to speak.
The 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo still did not utter a word.
Noah's gaze lingered on this unfathomably powerful being as his weavings echoed again.
"I advise because what you choose next will determine whether, in the weeks and months to come... the Hollow Concord of Nullity still exists.
Based on your choice, the names and weavings of the Mawbearers may either endure or be utterly erased across the folds of collapse and uncertainty."
His threat was unmistakable.
He made it clear- his weavings would persist even after all of this.
And if they continued on this path... he would hunt them down one by one until even the Nullvein Gravewake Folds forgot their dead weavings.
The silence after Noah's words was deafening.
On this day, he faced a scenario he had always feared.
A situation where enemies far too powerful for his current self made their presence known.
And no matter how brilliant his weavings were now...
They could not rise fast enough to change the tide in time.
Yet even with his warning, the eyes of Melodrass remained cold- without emotion.
His hand rose, higher than before, to strike another chord.
Veltraxis smiled so wide it seemed his face would split in half as his voice echoed.
"We are already dead- seeking the singular thing that will act as our salvation.
Do you think threats of death will deter us?"
His eyes burned with joy.
And beside him, the 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo finally spoke for the first time.
He spoke... three words, even as he struck a chord.
|Symphony of Death.|
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3704: Transform or Break I
paragraphs: Arthur, the Sea of Ash, howled in grief and fury. His body exploded into a massive gray ash sea that surged outward to cover everything.
The Witness tore off his blindfold- clear white eyes with no vision gleamed beneath.
And even then...
A Symphony of Death erupted and unfurled.
The Infinite Ravines trembled. Horrific tears bloomed, stretching out across Existence like a painting being shredded.
Like a doorway being broken- a rake rending apart everything.
The singular Gateway Domus ruptured with cascading tears, becoming torn and unmade, as the weavings of the Wheel of Existence and the Frequencies within it... were laid bare to all.
Noah closed his eyes.
Now, there was no going back.
Quintessence seethed and exploded.
Infinity, Cheats, and Paradox would soon follow!
But as of this moment, the goals changed to containment...and survival!
The Infinite Ravines tore like paper.
It was utterly terrifying- an entire doorway ripped apart in the span of an instant.
The power to accomplish such a thing... it defied imagination.
This wasn't simply a mark of power or complexity within the stages of Resplendent Monad or Converged Architect.
No, it was something far beyond, something that could not be grasped unless one stood at a similar pinnacle of existence.
At this moment, within the Prime Frequency of Wisdom.
RIIP!

The Infiniverse Megalos lifted her head above the vast Expanse of this Frequency, her fingers radiating quintillions upon quintillions of connections that surged outward, instantly rechanneling the source of Entities to herself and Noah's Living Wheel.
The Eldritch Expanse let itself run rampant. Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis erupted, washing over this Frequency.
Even the Infiniverse, beholding the tears in reality, found herself questioning this piece of her Master.
|You won't brag and claim your path was right?|
She addressed the swaying presence of Eldritch Expanse, the one that had once tried to bind all things under its rule.
But now... it remained silent. It had become a True Source of Existence within the Living Wheel.
Its power, instead of shrinking, became more profound- more horrifying.
And then, this part of Noah replied.
"Even I did not expect this, so I cannot claim anything."
The Eldritch Expanse remained calm amid the storm.
The Infiniverse nodded slowly, her gaze lifting to the sky- to the Infinite Ravines bleeding into the Frequencies of the Wheel.
|Master, for the sake of time, we may grant more leeway to the Eldritch Expanse. Its Absolute Frequency Ontopathogenesis can be used to spread our weavings swiftly.|
Ontopathogenesis.
The power to infect Existence itself—and now it bore the label: [Absolute Frequency].
The Infiniverse requested permission, and it was granted.
And then...
|The True Source of Veritarch imposes itself on the Eldritch Expanse and asks why.|
The Last System of Existence asked a question.
Why.
An unbearable question.
And yet, the Eldritch Expanse answered.
|For endless proliferation.|
HUUM!
An answer was given.
A heartbeat passed.
And then...
|Veritarch accepts the Why of Eldritch Expanse.|
|Absolute Frequency Ontopathogenesis has been elevated to Absolute Wheel Ontopathogenesis.|
Even the Infiniverse was genuinely stunned.
She gazed into the depths of her Master where Veritarch stirred, stretching its ancient limbs.
If only there had been more time.
If only Veltraxis and the other Mawbearers had not appeared.
If only the 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo had remained absent.
If only...
|There are too many ifs...|
The Infiniverse shook her head, tethering herself more closely to her Master.
And she closed her eyes.
Another fragment of her was already drifting across the golden sea, beyond the True Frequency of the Singed, approaching a dazzling golden-white Wheel.
The Wheel spun faster, as if sensing something.
Calmly, she traversed the boundless waters, coming infinitely close to the Wheel of Existence itself.
She had made a promise to save it before its last Breaking- to become a Wheel herself, to gain the strength to bypass the fate that had halted this one.
But so much had changed in so little time. The promise... now felt impossible to uphold.
It was a lesson.
She looked at the distant Wheel that felt so close now- close enough to touch.
And she whispered.
|I cannot incorporate you into myself as I did with so many others.|
She had done it before.
She had devoured entire worlds in her youth- when she had been no more than a spiritual land. Universes. Cosmos. Domains of Existence.
All consumed.
But not now.
Not anymore.
Since Omniverse X-999, she had fought to keep her Purity- knowing, somehow, that she would need it.
That if she were to ever succeed... she could not be tainted.
That was why, after the Witness had spoken, she and Noah had turned away, refusing to act upon the Wheel of Existence.
To absorb it... would mean contamination.
To devour it... would mean sealing her own fate- never moving forward.

|I cannot devour you, but to prepare for all outcomes and the countless lives you've protected for eons, I will send my weavings through your Frequencies. I will alter the source from which they draw... so they may find a bastion should the worst come to pass.|
The Worst.
If the Wheel of Existence were breached.
If the Wheel of Existence were broken.
They were preparing for that possibility.
And as the Infiniverse spoke, a thunderous hum erupted from the Wheel.
A signal. A plea.
The Infiniverse blinked, then nodded.

|If you wish to undergo your final Transformation now, I will lend you my Purity. My Master, who has already forged a Living Wheel, will lend his power. But know this, your chances of survival are infinitesimally low. I have not yet reached the point where I can guarantee your survival.|
She made the risk clear.
HUUM!
The Wheel responded.
It would proceed regardless.
For it had no more time left.
The Infiniverse stood still for a moment.
Then she nodded, lifting her hands and closing her eyes.
She reached out, connecting with her Master.
And she invoked power with unmatched brilliance.
|Absolute Wheel Ontopathogenesis.|
Black and white threads unfurled from her hands.
They surged into the spinning Wheel of Existence and met with no resistance- as the threads flooded into the unknown number of Spokes within.
Countless Channelers, drawn together under one banner.
And simultaneously, a Wheel chose to undergo its final Transformation.
A leap toward ascension... or toward annihilation.
For if it failed, it would become a Dead Wheel of Existence.
And all those still tethered to it would share its fate.

chapters.title: Chapter 3705: Transform or Break II
paragraphs: Life and death hung in the balance.
Literally.
At a time such as this when an utterly confounding existence tore apart the Infinite Ravines- it bled into the weavings of the Wheel of Existence.
Within Hell Terra Firma.
In the skies where a massive satellite floated, the figure of a tan-skinned Barbatos stood beside Noah as she watched a black-and-white tendril of light descend toward her from above.
"Is something serious happening right now?"
She asked Noah, her eyes tinged with curiosity.
Noah remained beside her, giving a light nod, his gaze resting on the bleak gray earth stretching endlessly across this hellish frequency.
"Somewhat serious. A lot of things will change. You... might change."
Barbatos blinked at his words, but a spark of understanding lit her eyes. She smiled.
"Is it... my other self? Or other Selves across frequencies?"
She had hit the heart of the matter.
Noah nodded.

"In the time to come, all weavings of existence will likely merge. By the time you attain your True Source, every possibility across frequencies that represents you will have unified. But you, and others closely tied to me, will become singular in nature, even if not yet in complexity soon. Across frequencies and possibilities, there will be only one Weaving of Existence. A single you, filled with all your possibilities."
Barbatos smiled and nodded brightly.
"As long as I am with you, I think everything will be okay."
She said this with unshakable joy. Noah nodded gently, and in the next moment, the black-gold string of the Eldritch Expanse struck the back of her head, her body falling completely still.
Across the Eldritch Expanse, countless black-and-white strings stretched out endlessly, connecting to all entities across this frequency and other Frequencies.
|Absolute Wheel Ontopathogenesis|...was unfolding in full bloom.
It spread across all frequencies of the Wheel of Existence, ignited from the very core of its construct.
Noah watched it unfold, his gaze calm.
Calculated.
He wasn't angry.
He wasn't sad.
He wasn't brimming with joy.
At this moment, he simply was.
He felt his own Weavings of Existence begin to stretch outward, reaching toward every possibility across the Wheel's frequencies as he reflected on himself.
He, who once vowed he could never fail.
But...
|The Truthborne Continuum, Veritarch, asks why.|
HUUM!
His weavings buzzed.
His last System of Existence, meant to embody all he was, questioned him.
Why couldn't Noah fail?
He had made mistakes.
He remembered his greatest one, the reason he turned back time itself to correct it.
The moment with the Devilish Time Unveiler.
And there were other mistakes. Even those he didn't call mistakes were still choices, paths he could have walked differently.
Yet each of them, mistake or not, had made him who he was.
Because he watched the Spiritual Land break, he swore never to allow such loss again.
Because he saw those he loved nearly die, he promised to protect them with everything he had.
His mistakes shaped him.
From them, he drew the conclusion that failure wasn't an option.
Why? Veritarch asked.
Why?
"Because I am... Noah Osmont."
HUUM!
"I am a father."
"I am a son."
"I am—"
|Veritarch, the Truthborne Continuum, rejects your reasoning.|
HUUM!
His weavings buzzed.
His eyes remained calm, solemn, as the depths of his budding Living Wheel shook.
His Final System of Existence rejected his answer.
And asked again.
He asked himself again.
|Why?|
BOOM!
Around him, Hell Terra Firma trembled.
Barbatos vanished along with countless others as the black-and-white tendrils of the Eldritch Expanse whisked them away.
In that moment, Noah became the only living existence within the bounds of Hell Terra Firma.
A place that denied all authority, and yet he overcame it.
A place where only he could now move freely.
And now, alone in this hellish frequency, he asked himself.
Why?
Not just why he couldn't fail.
But why he did it all.
Yes, for his family.
Yes, for those he wanted to protect.
Yes, for the countless quintillions relying on him.
But...
Why did he continue moving, endlessly?
HUUM!
His body pulsed with multicolored singularities.
Colorless brilliance surged outward as Quintessence flooded the gray terrain of Hell Terra Firma like an endless sea.
Mana flared, and in the next instant, the gray skies turned an endless, radiant blue.
Mana.
He looked up and smiled.
He always knew his answer.
His why.
He moved because...
"I want to."
No one forced him.
Yes, he had lives to protect. But no one stood behind him ordering him to act.
If his nature were different, if he didn't want to do this, then he simply wouldn't.
But he did.
It was part of the...pursuit.
It began with Infinite Mana.
He fell in love with the idea that he could wield boundless power to do anything.
Since then, he chased the very edges of what was possible.
How powerful could one become? How much could one obtain?
Along that path, he grew.
He found his family.
He had a son.
He reclaimed his mother.
All because he longed to witness the absolute end of power.
He loved the journey. The discovery.
He loved achieving what others couldn't imagine.
Doing in days what others required eons to accomplish.
Becoming a Resplendent Monad- of which only two existed in an entire Wheel of Existence that had survived eight Breakings.
The fact that it was possible...
That was why he loved this endless journey!
Yes, he couldn't fail- because to lose loved ones would be unbearable. To fail quintillions would be a tragedy.
But more than that...
His path would end.
His journey would stop.
And he didn't want that.
Like his Mana, he wanted it to be... Infinite.
He didn't want it to end. He wanted to keep experiencing.
Even if no battles remained. Even if he retired to a quiet farm...
He still wanted to continue.
To be alive, yes...but to truly live.
"That is why."
He answered the budding part of himself- the part trying to live up to its name: the Truthborne Continuum.
To synthesize. To understand.
And so...
|For now, Veritarch accepts the Why.|
HUUM!
|Your Origin, Body, and Soul have become the Cornerstones of the Living Wheel.|
|Through them, your Sources stand a chance to truly live.|

Colorless brilliance surged outward as Quintessence flooded the gray terrain of Hell Terra Firma like an endless sea.
Mana flared, and in the next instant, the gray skies turned an endless, radiant blue.
Mana.
He looked up and smiled.
He always knew his answer.
His why.
He moved because...
"I want to."
No one forced him.
Yes, he had lives to protect.
But no one stood behind him ordering him to act.
If his nature were different, if he didn't want to do this, then he simply wouldn't.
But he did.
It was part of the...pursuit.
It began with Infinite Mana.
He fell in love with the idea that he could wield boundless power to do anything.
Since then, he chased the very edges of what was possible.
How powerful could one become?
How much could one obtain?
Along that path, he grew.
He found his family.
He had a son.
He reclaimed his mother.
All because he longed to witness the absolute end of power.
He loved the journey.
The discovery.
He loved achieving what others couldn't imagine.
Doing in days what others required eons to accomplish.
Becoming a Resplendent Monad- of which only two existed in an entire Wheel of Existence that had survived eight Breakings.
The fact that it was possible...
That was why he loved this endless journey!
Yes, he couldn't fail- because to lose loved ones would be unbearable.
To fail quintillions would be a tragedy.
But more than that...
His path would end.
His journey would stop.
And he didn't want that.
Like his Mana, he wanted it to be...
Infinite.
He didn't want it to end.
He wanted to keep experiencing.
Even if no battles remained.
Even if he retired to a quiet farm...
He still wanted to continue.
To be alive, yes...but to truly live.
"That is why."
He answered the budding part of himself- the part trying to live up to its name: the Truthborne Continuum.
To synthesize.
To understand.
And so...
|For now, Veritarch accepts the Why.|
HUUM!
|Your Origin, Body, and Soul have become the Cornerstones of the Living Wheel.|
|Through them, your Sources stand a chance to truly live.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3706: Transform or Break III
paragraphs: Noah felt his Weavings become clearer.
He did not increase in purity or complexity, and yet he felt even more powerful.
His mind brimmed with indescribable clarity as he gazed around him, eyes that seemed to see through everything and himself all at once.
And in that moment, he arrived at a critical understanding about what was happening across the Wheel of Existence.
He could always prepare. He could always ensure no mistakes were made or correct them if they were. Because he was...human, wasn't he?
He...was human, right?
If he made mistakes, he would amend them.
But even after all that, even with all the planning, all the foresight across the vast stretches of existence, even after calculating for countless variables...
Sometimes...
"Shit happens."
WAA!
Yes.
Along this endless path he walked, he had encountered this truth more than once.
He had planned. Prepared. And yet something utterly unfathomable would occur- something that would have derailed any other man.
But he always overcame it. His sheer explosiveness in short bursts of power shattered obstacles others couldn't even comprehend.
Bob had been the most recent example.
A lot of shit had happened with him- situations that would've left anyone else floundering.
But Noah prevailed.
This time, it was the Mawbearers of the Hollow Concord of Nullity. And it could be argued that even this...was somehow tied to him.
His presence in the Infinite Ravines had drawn the gaze of a Dead Thing. That creature had reported directly to Veltraxis, setting off a chain of consequences.
Sometimes, events spun beyond one's wildest control.
And when they did, all one could do was adapt.
If Noah couldn't overpower the present threat now, he would do so later.
Because his path would not end here.
And while he was here, while he endured and continued, he would do everything he could for those bound to him by fate and Weavings.
So.
The Eldritch Expanse stretched outward, spreading across the Wheel of Existence.
Countless Channelers became his, merging into the budding Spokes of the Infiniverse Wheel of Existence.
He was preparing for the worst-case scenario, but it remained only that. A possibility. Nothing more.
And he would continue onward. Advancing regardless of the eventual results.
On his Infinite path!
|You have gained a slightly more advanced understanding of your nature.|
|From the core of your Living Wheel, the Autognosis Living Engine blooms.|
|An Engine to generate Living Paradoxes that autocorrect their internal contradiction via endless growth.|
|You have advanced from an Administrator of the Absolute Complex Atlas Living Wheel to become its Developer.|
|Within your Living Wheel, the Autognosis Living Engine brings up the Paradox of Amalgamation of Existence that you entirely skipped.|
|Your Autognosis Living Engine poses the first Living Paradox and asks...just what is a True Source?|
HUUM!
Noah closed his eyes.
In the depths of his Weavings, a Living Wheel began to spin- and at its core, by answering the Why of Veritarch, the Truthborne Continuum...his Aspects of Existence became its foundation.
He understood himself- if only slightly- more.
And from that, the Autognosis Living Engine was born, at the very center of the Living Wheel.
Spokes formed and stretched from its heart to the Rim.
Autognosis.
Self-knowledge. An understanding of one's own dynamics, character, and peculiarities.
And in this moment, it birthed a Living Paradox for him to solve.
The Paradox of True Sources.
How had he obtained any of them without undergoing Amalgamation-.like everyone else?
To solve such a Living Paradox, of course he would need...
"O Paradox."
In the gray brilliance of Hell Terra Firma- colorless sea below, cerulean sky above- he spoke the words aloud.
And...
|The True Source of Paradox has always been born.|
A confounding statement bloomed into existence. Noah regarded it calmly, then looked inward.
What was a True Source?
To find the answer, he would witness and participate in the Weavings of fantastical, living, and dead True Sources alike.
His why was certain.
He would seek the answer, and he would live.
No matter what happened, he would endure.
Those he now faced wielded a complexity he might not match today. Or tomorrow. Or even next week.
But through them, he would learn. And he would see further along the Infinite Path that he refused to abandon.
So...
"Lead the way, Paradox."
He spoke to another blooming part of himself.
|Paradox, the recursive heartbeat of contradiction that fuels evolution and possibilities beyond limits, begins to move.|
At this moment.
BOOM!
As the Infinite Ravines tore and Weavings of Dead Things spread across the Frequencies of the Wheel.
Suddenly, the glee on Veltraxis' face halted. His smile faded as he frowned, glancing around.
Something had shifted. He could feel it, but not define it.
He wasn't alone. The surrounding Mawbearers stirred, uneasy. Something was...off.
Even the 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo furrowed his brow. Beside him, Veltraxis muttered.
"I feel as if something has changed, but I cannot quite place my Weavings upon it."
His grin remained horrific, but behind it, unease flickered.
By now, the Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity Dead Things had already been sent forth, diving into exposed Frequencies, ready to feed.
"Yes, I wonder what has changed."
Veltraxis heard a voice, right beside him.
A man stood there in golden Emperor's robes.
Veltraxis appeared calm until his dead eyes sharpened. His fist dropped, releasing a shockwave of collapsing Weavings of Nullvein Gravewake Folds toward a figure that had appeared midair!
Noah.
BOOM!
The devastating Weavings struck, dispersing the image instantly.
But a heartbeat later, the figure reformed—calmly—before the gathered Mawbearers, as if he'd never vanished.
Veltraxis' eyes flared as he turned toward the distance of a vast gray-ash sea painted with blood.
The Living Defenders were tattered, broken. There, the original Noah remained, flanked by a gravely wounded Arthur and the Witness.
And yet...he was also here.
The Mythic True Signatures once locked down by the 9th Mawbearer had somehow vanished.
Now...
Veltraxis' grin widened.
"What is this? I can sense that you are no threat to me—and yet...I cannot touch your Weavings? How absurd must you become, O Favored Living Thing?"

chapters.title: Chapter 3707: Transform or Break IV
paragraphs: Yes.
Veltraxis could feel it.
Noah was both here, and not.
Noah nodded slowly.

"A Paradox, isn't it? I may be here. I may not. My threat still stands, and I'll act early since you all did not listen. I cannot yet challenge your Mawbearers. Your Complexity...it's beyond me for now. For...now. And you..."
He turned his gaze to the 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo.
Melodrass.
"You, who stands even further beyond was a heavy enigma. But I am redefining myself. And it seems I must learn more- about True Sources. Mine, yours, and everyone elses."
His expression hardened.

"You ignored my threat. So now, I'll use your forces as experiments to understand, starting with you Harmonized Sourcebound Icons and Converged Architects. O Mawbearers of the Hollow Concord of Nullity."
He would use their Harmonized Sourcebound Icons and Converged Architects to understand!
Veltraxis and the other Mawbearers heard this as their Complexities exploded- thundering toward Noah's figure. Yet Melodrass... did not move.
As if he could see through the illusion laid before them.
And Noah, seeing this, gave the powerful being a nod of recognition.
"This guy gets it. The slight weavings of Paradox."
BOOM!
Multiple complex Dead True Sources thundered where Noah's body should have been- yet they flickered through him, as if he wasn't truly there.
Melodrass alone remained still, as if aware that an attack here would be meaningless.
For the first time, he raised his hand- commandingly, as if issuing an order to the other Mawbearers.
His voice, rarely heard, emerged not from his lips, but from the instrument his fingers played. And through it, a voice tinged with weight echoed out.

|This Favored Living Thing Veltraxis has found is... somewhat unique. Just now, he retracted all his Weavings of Existence deep into the Wheel. What he left behind are Paradoxes- among the most difficult True Sources to grasp, whether Living or Dead. To capture his Weavings, we must find the place where he converged everything. Spread into the Frequencies of this Wheel of Existence. Corner him. Let us draw out his true self, free of Paradoxes. But for now, some of you...|
He glanced at the distant figures- Dead Things bearing complexity at the Harmonized Sourcebound Icon level, and others not at the level of Mawbearers yet, but still at the Converged Architect stage.
He looked again, and in that moment, multiple figures resembling Noah appeared across the ruptured Infinite Ravines, their Weavings surging.
|Try and protect the others.|
TRIING!
He struck another chord.
A terrifying Complexity bloomed.
And a distant Noah watched with cold eyes as another 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo appeared- Melodrass.
Two bodies.

|One of me will claim the Wheel. The other shall remain here. I've summoned Old 6th in case we need his help securing and locking down particularly difficult True Sources—of which this entity...has many. This is of great interest to us as of now. Veltraxis, well done.|
One Melodrass spoke before vanishing in a streak of light, like a dead star streaking across the rending Frequencies of the Wheel.
The other struck another chord, sending waves of deathly brilliance crashing into Noah's multiple bodies that flickered in and out of existence.
BOOM!
More than half dispersed.
But more bloomed instantly.
One Noah now stood before a Converged Architect resembling a skeletal centipede.
His eyes were serene.
He spoke.
"O True Source of the Singed... how have I been using you? What... are you?"
HUUM!
His bodies buzzed.
Each one erupted in white-gold flames.
No Pillars of Concordance. No Mythic True Signatures.
Just flames.
Just a Source.
Others declared Ordinances that aligned with their Weavings of Existence- paths they believed were true to them. They then underwent Amalgamation- becoming one with that Ordinance.
Only then did they sever it from Existence.
Only then did they pioneer their Pathways, complexity rising until they formed their Source.
Lesser. Greater. Prime. Some so undeniable they became... True.
Once True, one no longer needed a Wheel. Their True Source alone sustained them.
Their True Source became the core of their Origin, Body, and Soul.
Its greatness and its limits defined them forevermore.
But Noah... didn't walk that path.
He never underwent full Amalgamation.
Before severing, he never unified with his Ordinance.
When he did sever, he did so 81 times.
His path? Unfathomably unique.
By the time he completed his Pathway, he already had a Source that was True.
But it wasn't fully his. Not in a True sense.
At this moment, he located the Singed relative to his Living Wheel.
It was anchored- not amalgamated, to a Cornerstone.
Its purity and complexity were his. Yet his whole existence didn't express it, only a part of him did.
He had other True Sources anchored to other Cornerstones of his Living Wheel.
So when he used the Singed, he wielded only a part of its power. Not all of him expressed it. Not all of his Wheel expressed it.
If it had been amalgamated before the Living Wheel formed, it would have dominated his entire being.
Others would never have surfaced.
Infinity. Cheats. Quintessence. Manadynamics. All would have dimmed under the first Amalgamated True Source.
That... was the reality of existence minutes ago.
But now?
Now, with the emergence of Veritarch, the Truthborne Continuum.
With the Living Wheel.
With the Autognosis Living Engine, whose Spokes reached into his Wheel's Cornerstones.
Now, as he became the Developer of the Absolute Complex Atlas Living Wheel!
Now, Noah could amalgamate a True Source into himself and...not.
He could both unify and not unify.
He could amalgamate others.
Living Paradoxes let him answer the paradox of Amalgamation.
The answer to the question posed by the Autognosis Living Engine...
Was the Engine itself.
It was the answer... to its own question.
It asked him.
What is a True Source?
And now, Noah opened his eyes and answered.
"I do not possess a True Source. It's not about possession. A True Source... is what becomes inevitable through the expression of Existence itself."
WAA!
As he spoke, he allowed the Singed to move.
To spread from its Cornerstone.
To flow into the Autognosis Living Engine at the heart of the Wheel.
To paradoxically amalgamate, and not amalgamate.
This was the birth of something few could even imagine.
And the moment it began...
The white-gold flames surrounding Noah changed.
Their makeup...broke down before they formed again, made from countless particles that looked like miniature white gold Wheels!
And they burst forward- appearing instantly on nearby Converged Architects.
One Dead Thing howled, its Mythic True Signature beginning to form.
Beginning... to rise.
But...
It never did.
The flames born from countless particles of white gold wheels consumed it as it bloomed.
Not a Pillar of Concordance. Not a Signature.
Just the Singed.
Its expression on the path of Amalgamation was enough to tear through the high complexity and average purity of a Converged Architect.
And now, multiple Noahs stood before Converged Architects.
Even though Melodrass had destroyed half, more remained and more formed!
Their white-gold flames surged.
Over a dozen Converged Architect Dead Things were caught in the blaze.
Their Dead True Sources which were budding with their massive Mythic True Signatures...
Burned.
Burned like paper.
And Noah...
Was just getting started!

chapters.title: Chapter 3708: Transform or Break V
paragraphs: Without utilizing the Pillars of Concordance unique to Harmonized Sourcebound Icons.
Without utilizing Mythic True Signatures unique to Converged Architects or Resplendent Monads.
Simply through the exertion of the True Source of the Singed, Noah broke down and utterly rejected the Dead True Sources of multiple Converged Architects!
Creatures of High Complexity... and below-average Purity.
When faced with his understanding- his true, unfettered grasp of what a True Source was, paired with the fact that he was now undergoing Amalgamation for the first time...
The so-called "simple" Dead True Sources stood no chance.
Not when their Purity was that low.
If those Converged Architects had held High Complexity and Moderate or High Purity, perhaps like the Mawbearers like Veltraxis, they might've stood a chance.
But they didn't.

Like the brittle pages of an ancient, arid book, the Converged Architects and Harmonized Sourcebound Icons burned, then faded, only to be pulled inward by golden tendrils of light, converging on Noah's chest, where an invisible, spinning Cradle of Purity resided.
The scene, mid-collapse of the Infinite Ravines' weavings and the penetration of the frequencies of the Wheel of Existence, was unparalleled. It drew the stunned gazes of distant, remaining Legends.

And even as Noah's bodies rose among the dead things in the far distance, one of them remained near the weavings of the gray Ash Sea, where the Witness and the one responsible for spreading this endless sea of ash turned toward him.
The Sea of Ash regarded him.
Surviving the breaking of a Wheel of Existence, and remaining within its weavings made the Sea of Ash something exceptional. Others had been cast out. He remained.
Now, as he watched the True Sources of other defenders break beneath the might of the 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo, he could not help but ask Noah.
"You've shown us things many have never seen. Even my evaluation of you was... wrong. So I ask, are there more secrets hidden within you that could somehow stop what seems inevitable?"
The Sea of Ash spoke with weighty words- but he was, essentially, asking if they were doomed.
To such a question, Noah only shook his head.

"At this time, I cannot stand against the 9th Mawbearer of the Dissonant Echo. And it seems others at his level are still arriving. The weavings of these Dead Things are hell-bent on enforcing the inevitable. I would prepare for the decimation of the Wheel of Existence... and your own weavings."
He was honest.
There was no emotion behind it. Just truth.
And hearing it, the nearby defenders became ashen.
The Omnifather, still surviving by the miracles of Versality, trembled with fury. He roared toward the Dead Things.
"Countless lives. COUNTLESS! All of them will perish. Turn dead. I...!"
Hopelessness and shame echoed in the hearts of all present- for they had fought for so long, only to find themselves lacking the strength to continue.
The Omnifather thought back to the genocide of Megalonians across the frequencies that he could not prevent.
Was he doomed to witness such a thing again?
Weavings of doubt and deterioration spread all around.
But even then, Noah remained calm.

"I have already emptied 75% of all Living Weavings of Existence across every Frequency of the Wheel. In another minute, that number will reach 100%. After that, should they ravage the Frequencies, there will be no living left to harm."
His words seemed like fiction.
A soft lie to soothe the agony in their weavings.
The Stellar Weaver stared at him, disbelief etched across her features. Meanwhile, the half-decimated Origin Singed laughed, his body unraveling into light.
"Of course you did... only you could. Then I will have no reservations. I'll find what opportunities I can in this sea of Dead Weavings, my friend."
The Great Usurper spoke as the Origin Singed's weavings dispersed- dissolving, seemingly dying.
But Noah knew. The Usurper was a parasite- pathogenic, like the Eldritch Expanse, but quieter... more insidious. His weavings crept now toward the unsuspecting Dead Things in the distance.
He accepted Noah's words without question. But the other defenders of the Wheel stood between belief and dismissal.
"Truly?"
Arthur, the Sea of Ash, sought confirmation.
It did not come from Noah.
Instead, the Witness turned his blank eyes upon him. A faint golden light radiated from within, growing in intensity, until a grandiose Mythic True Signature began to rise.
"His words bear no falsehood. It is... true."
Relief flooded the remaining legends.
They accepted this truth. And in that truth, they found release- knowing that at the very least, their failure would not bring about the blood of all living things on their hands.
Now, only one test remained.
The weavings of choice. Of decisions.
Would their True Sources survive the coming day?
Would they remain alive... or become just another chapter of the dead?
These were the weavings.
These were the choices.
And Noah... was making his own.
|Your weavings have undergone Amalgamation of a True Source of Existence for the first time.|
|The True Source of the Singed has been Amalgamated into the Autognosis Living Engine of your Living Wheel... and it also has not.|
|The Living Paradox, the Paradox of the Amalgamation of Existence, has been resolved.|
|The True Source of the Singed is Paradoxically amalgamated to your Living Wheel, and has become... a Living True Source of the Singed.|
HUUM!
Noah blinked.
What was this?
True Sources had always been referred to as simply that- True Sources.
If dead, the distinction would be made. Dead True Sources.
But this?
As if the Singed had not been alive before, the system now granted it a new designation- a Living True Source.
Not that it hadn't been part of the living... but now?
Now, it truly lived beneath his weavings.
It was truly alive!
He could wield it freely. Fully.
But that wasn't all.
His Living Wheel wasn't done.
A profound sense of fulfillment blossomed within him as something stirred deep in the core of his Wheel- something blooming from the Amalgamation of his first Living True Source... and also not.
From the Autognosis Living Engine...

|Due to resolving a Living Paradox and Amalgamating with a Living True Source for the first time, the Absolute Complex Amalgamation Ability, Paradox Genesis, is now available to utilize in the Autognosis Living Engine.|
From his Living Wheel.
From the very heart of the Autognosis Living Engine where Living Paradoxes bloomed...
An ability awakened.
An Absolute Complex Amalgamation Ability called...Paradox Genesis!
