chapters.title: Chapter 3728: Death and Prophecy II
paragraphs: For Noah, the breaking of the Wheel and the apocalyptic unraveling that followed triggered more than just destruction.
It triggered possibility.
His eyes flickered with brilliance as cascading prompts descended before him.
|Your Pathway to the True Sources of Apocalypse and Cataclysm has been walked thoroughly, becoming distinguished, complex, and pure enough to evolve into True Sources of Existence.|
Different parts of him rose, gloriously awakened.

And this was occurring even without the infusion of complexities currently being purified in the Cradle of Purity, complexities that included multiple Harmonized Sourcebound Icons and Converged Architects, all of them sourced from the Hollow Concord of Nullity.
The only Converged Architects he hadn't yet killed were the Mawbearers.

But once he finally took the time to sit, reflect, and absorb everything he had devoured, he expected many of his Pathways to True Sources would complete. Then, he could begin the process of Amalgamation, transforming them into Living True Sources of Existence as he enacted his Living Wheel and intricately designed its structure.
That was his path forward.
His future, unfolding.
And then there were the others.
Ruination.
The Infiniverse Wheel of Existence.

In this moment, their Complexity surged. Almost neck and neck. Ruination had consumed the core of the collapsing Wheel of Existence, bearing witness to its final ruin. For a brief heartbeat, their intricacies aligned a little while ago.
But the Infiniverse had just finished forming the True Frequency of Manadynamics, and had begun weaving multiple others simultaneously. It pulled ahead again, widening the gap.
Noah only smiled.
"Are you two ready?" he asked gently.
As they stood at the edge of the Wheel's end, even isolated as they were, the transformation from living to dead felt like it left a taint, a lingering shadow pressing into the soul.
If it wasn't necessary to bear it... they would leave. Before the stillness turned them into something less.
After all, his other self would bear the taint fully. Would become something between Dead and Living. Ozymandias would see it all!
The Infiniverse nodded, calm and certain.
Ruination looked upon the fading golden hues, now graying into death. Her voice, when it came, was solemn and epiphanic.

"So this is how it ends...not with screams, but with silence devouring existence itself. Death was never cruel, it was certain, and fair to all. Ruin was never chaos...it was purpose fulfilled. Simply an end. And the Wheel... it spun too long after Ruin tainted it. Now... it shall lie still. Endlessly so."
Her words carried weight. And behind them, she burst with Complexity, her weavings strong enough to suppress a Resplendent Monad like the Sea of Ash with ease.
She turned to Noah and nodded.
"My gains will only increase as I go through the Nine Breakings of the Wheel of Existence. In their fracture, I see endless potential."
They were both ready.
And so...
Noah offered a light nod, and they vanished.
And elsewhere, deep within the True Frequency of the Singed, now layered in dreary, death-stained Existential Dimensional Lattices, Noah's body burned in blue flame.
Here, Primarch Vaethrava, the Withering Sealroot, roared, the torn Frequency echoing with fury.
She had heard.
That Noah had escaped the grasp of another Primarch already!
Noah's gaze calmly met Vaethrava's. He observed the Dimensional Lattices laid before him, and he spoke softly.

"You reminded me of the wonders of Dimensions and Dimensionality with your Existential Dimensional Lattices. I thank you for this. When we meet again, I think I'll collapse your existence with something... related."
His tone was relaxed. As if they were old friends exchanging promises over coffee.
And then he stepped forward and disappeared from the countless restrictions of the Lattices.
Because Ember Eternum, the Transient Paradoxical Living True Source, could not be contained!
Not by any prison.
Not by any force.
Not here.
In the death-ridden Weave where Hell Terra Firma had once stood, another of his bodies faded.
All of him...collapsed into the Infiniverse Wheel of Existence.
And in that moment, the Infiniverse, no more than a twinkle, a speck of warping sand, disappeared entirely from the dying Wheel.
From a dying Omniverse X-999.
It had taken its first step...into the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
A moment heavy with importance.
A moment radiant with brilliance.
And behind, still in the decaying Wheel... in the Prime Frequency of the End... stood Ozymandias.
His arms spread wide, basked in death and ruin.
He stood upon the line between life and death, feeling the minute shifts and changes in real time.
And with it came something unique.
Something sacred.
In the instant that Ozymandias stood at that threshold, between Living Thing and Dead Thing...
|A Unique Phenomenon has triggered the weavings of the Protagonist, Quintessence, Cheats, Plot, and Infinity.|
|The weavings of the Protagonist lead the way with the emergence of the Absolute Infinitum Prophecy.|

|The junction between Dead and Living has provided a temporary resonance of an unknown state of being, allowing for an immense possible burst of threads of external weavings in the Folds to be observed through the Absolute Infinitum Prophecy, both for those tangled with you and those not.|
|To receive feedback, your weavings must be released. There is a risk. Other unknown forces may capture them in thread fragments.|
|Shall the Absolute Infinitum Prophecy proceed?|
A choice.
A rare state, possibly never to occur again.
With it came the emergence of something even more rare: the ability to release one's weavings into the Folds and glimpse possibilities of the future.
Noah weighed the risk.
And...
"Proceed."
HUUM!
The command was given.
And brilliance unfolded.
His weavings erupted from the Prime Frequency of the End and spilled into the Folds.
Wondrously.
Inconceivably.
Unimaginably.
It lasted but a second.
And in the next heartbeat, waves of Complexity came rushing back.
Multiple True Sources buzzed in response.
After all, Ozymandias was, paradoxically, both Noah and not Noah.
Even the Living True Source of Ember Eternum pulsed in a distant region of the Folds.
And then...
From Ozymandias who was standing between life and death, a voice emerged.
Ancient.
Heavy.
Unfathomably vast.
It carried knowledge not even he understood.
And with it flowed the words of a Prophecy:
|When the Ninth Echo of the Wheel fractures, the Flame Between shall stir.
A Favored born of paradox shall rise where even the Folds dare not dream, its shadow cast across broken time and Living flame.
The one who sings with stolen notes shall tempt the Dead into life.
The one who weaves without thread shall walk into the Cradle of Threads and emerge wearing the Crown of a Song that was never written.
Three Doors will open, but only two may be entered. One leads to the Hour Beyond Hours. One leads to the Mouth That Does Not Chew. One is a lie.
When the Gauntlet burns, the Foldtree will bleed. And from its hollowed roots, an Emergence of Rot will awaken the Garden of Stillness.
The Black Monarch on a fold throne will offer choice, but not freedom. The Sentinels of Reversal will ask for the paradoxical Keys that should not exist.
One will walk away empty. One will walk away whole. One will not walk away.
Beware the day when Death sings in living tongues. On that day, the &$%@&%$# Ones shall stir, Those neither bound by Life nor caged by Death.
Their names will not be remembered, for they were never written. Their weavings cannot be unspun. Their will cannot be undone.
In the end, the Thread that was favored shall not be the one that remains. But the Thread that learned to twist itself.
The Gravewake shall open. The Nine Breakings shall echo. And in the silence after the final fall, only a single note shall endure, Not a sound, but a choice.|
BOOM!

"My gains will only increase as I go through the Nine Breakings of the Wheel of Existence.
In their fracture, I see endless potential."
They were both ready.
And so...
Noah offered a light nod, and they vanished.
And elsewhere, deep within the True Frequency of the Singed, now layered in dreary, death-stained Existential Dimensional Lattices, Noah's body burned in blue flame.
Here, Primarch Vaethrava, the Withering Sealroot, roared, the torn Frequency echoing with fury.
She had heard.
That Noah had escaped the grasp of another Primarch already!
Noah's gaze calmly met Vaethrava's.
He observed the Dimensional Lattices laid before him, and he spoke softly.
"You reminded me of the wonders of Dimensions and Dimensionality with your Existential Dimensional Lattices.
I thank you for this.
When we meet again, I think I'll collapse your existence with something... related."
His tone was relaxed.
As if they were old friends exchanging promises over coffee.
And then he stepped forward and disappeared from the countless restrictions of the Lattices.
Because Ember Eternum, the Transient Paradoxical Living True Source, could not be contained!
Not by any prison.
Not by any force.
Not here.
In the death-ridden Weave where Hell Terra Firma had once stood, another of his bodies faded.
All of him...collapsed into the Infiniverse Wheel of Existence.
And in that moment, the Infiniverse, no more than a twinkle, a speck of warping sand, disappeared entirely from the dying Wheel.
From a dying Omniverse X-999.
It had taken its first step...into the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
A moment heavy with importance.
A moment radiant with brilliance.
And behind, still in the decaying Wheel... in the Prime Frequency of the End... stood Ozymandias.
His arms spread wide, basked in death and ruin.
He stood upon the line between life and death, feeling the minute shifts and changes in real time.
And with it came something unique.
Something sacred.
In the instant that Ozymandias stood at that threshold, between Living Thing and Dead Thing...
|A Unique Phenomenon has triggered the weavings of the Protagonist, Quintessence, Cheats, Plot, and Infinity.|
|The weavings of the Protagonist lead the way with the emergence of the Absolute Infinitum Prophecy.|

|The junction between Dead and Living has provided a temporary resonance of an unknown state of being, allowing for an immense possible burst of threads of external weavings in the Folds to be observed through the Absolute Infinitum Prophecy, both for those tangled with you and those not.|
|To receive feedback, your weavings must be released.
There is a risk.
Other unknown forces may capture them in thread fragments.|
|Shall the Absolute Infinitum Prophecy proceed?|
A choice.
A rare state, possibly never to occur again.
With it came the emergence of something even more rare: the ability to release one's weavings into the Folds and glimpse possibilities of the future.
Noah weighed the risk.
And...
"Proceed."
HUUM!
The command was given.
And brilliance unfolded.
His weavings erupted from the Prime Frequency of the End and spilled into the Folds.
Wondrously.
Inconceivably.
Unimaginably.
It lasted but a second.
And in the next heartbeat, waves of Complexity came rushing back.
Multiple True Sources buzzed in response.
After all, Ozymandias was, paradoxically, both Noah and not Noah.
Even the Living True Source of Ember Eternum pulsed in a distant region of the Folds.
And then...
From Ozymandias who was standing between life and death, a voice emerged.
Ancient.
Heavy.
Unfathomably vast.
It carried knowledge not even he understood.
And with it flowed the words of a Prophecy:
|When the Ninth Echo of the Wheel fractures, the Flame Between shall stir.
A Favored born of paradox shall rise where even the Folds dare not dream, its shadow cast across broken time and Living flame.
The one who sings with stolen notes shall tempt the Dead into life.
The one who weaves without thread shall walk into the Cradle of Threads and emerge wearing the Crown of a Song that was never written.
Three Doors will open, but only two may be entered.
One leads to the Hour Beyond Hours.
One leads to the Mouth That Does Not Chew.
One is a lie.
When the Gauntlet burns, the Foldtree will bleed.
And from its hollowed roots, an Emergence of Rot will awaken the Garden of Stillness.
The Black Monarch on a fold throne will offer choice, but not freedom.
The Sentinels of Reversal will ask for the paradoxical Keys that should not exist.
One will walk away empty.
One will walk away whole.
One will not walk away.
Beware the day when Death sings in living tongues.
On that day, the &$%@&%$# Ones shall stir, Those neither bound by Life nor caged by Death.
Their names will not be remembered, for they were never written.
Their weavings cannot be unspun.
Their will cannot be undone.
In the end, the Thread that was favored shall not be the one that remains.
But the Thread that learned to twist itself.
The Gravewake shall open.
The Nine Breakings shall echo.
And in the silence after the final fall, only a single note shall endure, Not a sound, but a choice.|
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3729: Crucible I
paragraphs: The prophecy was something unfathomably grand.
Even as Ozymandias said it, the content made his mind buzz, as he could only fully understand, or guess, at a few of the lines in the prophecy.
And when the prophecy ended...
HUUUM!
Everything in the surroundings rumbled and roiled.
The Prime Frequency of the End became bathed entirely in death, and at that moment...
Ozymandias crossed the line between Life and Death.
That unique state faded.
And he began to feel his weavings of existence undergo a transformation of unfathomable wonders!
|The pathways to the True Sources of Life and Death observe significant milestones and take their step to become True Sources.|
Prompts came and went.
But Ozymandias, Noah, could not stop thinking about the prophecy he had just uttered.
He sensed all the changes occurring, they were critical, yes, but that prophecy!
[When the Ninth Echo of the Wheel fractures, the Flame Between shall stir.]
The early point of the prophecy was one of the easier ones to analyze and understand.
The Ninth Echo of the Wheel, the fracturing, and the flame that stirs in between...should signal the moment when the Ninth Breaking of the Wheel of Existence occurs.
The "Flame Between" should refer to Ozymandias entering the state between Life and Death, a transitional paradox that allowed the Absolute Infinitum Prophecy to manifest!
And then...
[A Favored born of paradox shall rise where even the Folds dare not dream, its shadow cast across broken time and Living flame.]
A Favored born of paradox.
This...should refer to the weavings of the Protagonist!

How Noah was able to influence external weavings of existence enough that others saw him as some True Favored Living Thing. His power disrupted many things, as those from the Hollow Concord of Nullity and the Chronosect of Threadbound Folds were pulled in.
These first lines of the prophecy were easy to analyze and understand, but the others could mean multiple things!
"One who sings with stolen notes...those neither bound by Life nor caged by Death..."
The mesmerizing voice of Ozymandias echoed out as he recited some scattered lines of the prophecy.
Lines that could have a variety of meanings.
But the latter lines spoke of something that was actually covered by indecipherable words.
It spoke of entities neither bound by life nor death.
And their weavings were so complex to understand that Noah was not even able to obtain their names or distinctions!
Entities that neither fit the definition of the Living nor the Dead.
Noah's weavings thought about them as he continued to bask in the wild weavings of death and decimation that began to spread all around.
The very concept of the End that represented this Prime Frequency was gradually being altered, as it gained an even grander quality of death.
And in the midst of all of this...
|You have gained the designation of a Dead Thing.|
|Untethered from life, your weavings of Existence present with a gradual Absolute Undeniable Decay, your Purity of Existence constantly tainted and becoming more impure.|
|Untethered from life, your weavings of Existence will collapse if your Purity and Complexity are degraded to a certain extent.|

|Untethered from life, the rate of increasing your Complexity is much faster, as you are no longer bound by life's limitations, with your Weavings of Existence further amplified in the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.|
Within Ozymandias, the weavings of a Dead Thing fully unfurled as he studied them while coming to a grand conclusion, his voice echoing out across the endless expanse of death.

"Dead wings of existence...clarity beyond breath, beyond blood. Life was a flicker, but this... this is structure unbound. Memory solidifies and scatters while potential multiplies. No hunger. No fear. Only a calling and connection to the Folds...enduring Complexity and a fight of Purity!"
HUUM!
A deeper connection to the Folds, greater Complexity, and a fight for Purity!
This was why any Dead Thing that was a Resplendent Monad with High Purity was terrifying, since they had overcome this detriment of Purity alongside their high Complexity.
It was also why many Dead Things could become Converged Architects with High Complexity, their rate of progression much faster!
Now, Noah would take this rate of progression...while keeping his unfathomable Purity for his other half that contained interminable purity.
This...was just the beginning!
Ozymandias basked in the weavings of death and learned more of what it meant to be a Dead Thing.
In the decaying Infinite Ravines...
"Haa...haa...fuck!"
A Converged Architect that was a half-shattered obsidian skull floated with tentacles of obsidian wings behind it, as it barely survived the rampage of the enraged second body of Primarch Eluriah.
It felt the overabundance of death now permeating all around as its body naturally began to absorb the surrounding deathly weavings.

As it did, it sensed the scattered Mawbearers who had already run into the Folds, and it followed, unaware that the vibrant weavings of death it was devouring...were filled with a silent will of a certain Great Usurper that permeated to fill its True Source!
Across the decimation of death.
In the Dead True Frequency of the Singed.
Flickering black flames came and went all around, as the figure of the Primarch Vaethrava, the Withering Sealroot, had transformed into a dark-skinned woman of pristine deathly beauty.
A bejeweled obsidian dress made of trillions of dead trees covered her as she spoke to Melodrass.
"Continue scouring this Dead Wheel of Existence. If anything leading to the Loom is here, we will fin—...!"
HUUM!
Primarch Vaethrava trembled in shock and horror immediately after, as she raised her head!
A moment after she finished speaking, far above them, the weavings of flickering black flames of death burst, above, a massive obsidian-gold eye instantly bloomed!
An eye...emanating dreadful Complexity as it looked around, eventually locking onto Primarch Vaethrava and showing annoyance.
|Another false alarm...You, stop uttering the names of things you do not understand. I will let you off with a warning today so you can act as a warning to others.|
Stop uttering names of things it did not understand.
The name of...the Loom!
THAT!
Some beings inherently only referred to it as THAT.
Never directly saying the word, because sometimes, it might just draw the attention of beings others could not even imagine!
Primarch Vaethrava trembled and nodded as the eye above closed its obsidian pupil and disappeared.
